title: Physics-Knowledge-Guided Hybrid Neural Learning for Arctic Sea Ice Concentration Evolution and Short-Range Prediction
summary: Accurate modeling of sea ice concentration (SIC) evolution is essential for polar climate assessment and short?range sea ice prediction. Numerical and data-driven approaches constitute major foundations for SIC modeling, but the former often require complex parameterizations and substantial compu?tation, whereas the latter rarely encode physical dependencies explicitly. This study presents the Physics-Informed Hybrid Ice Model (PIHIM), a differentiable data-driven hybrid ice model for daily SIC evolution that organizes its network structure according to the physical dependencies encoded in the sea ice continuity equation and explicitly accounts for dynamical transport, ther?modynamically driven areal growth and loss, and unresolved local processes. PIHIM preserves the representation capacity of deep learning while providing a process-decomposed formulation of ice displacement, freeze-melt areal change, and local error closure. Two evaluation settings are adopted: reanalysis-forced simulation examines SIC evolution stability under reanalysis forcing, and forecast-forced prediction assesses short-range performance un?der forecast-forced conditions, with reanalysis and observational SIC serving as verification references. Results indicate enhanced ice-edge preservation and error-growth control in reanalysis?forced simulation, while PIHIM retains measurable short-range prediction skill under forecast-forced conditions. Our code will be made publicly available after the paper is accepted.

title: FlashReg: GPU-Accelerated 3-Clique Point Cloud Registration for Real-Time Correspondence-to-Pose Estimation
summary: Graph-based point cloud registration achieves high robustness by identifying geometrically consistent correspondence sets, but constructing second-order compatibility graphs and enumerating candidate cliques remain compute- and memory-intensive. This work presents FlashReg, a GPU-oriented correspondence-to-pose estimator that avoids materializing the dense scored second-order graph. Its Fast First- and Second-Order Graph (FFSOG) construction builds a capacity-bounded sparse second-order graph directly from the binary first-order graph. A dataflow-optimized three-node clique (3-clique) search then selects pivots from compact per-row candidate pools and enumerates triples through sorted sparse-neighborhood intersections. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, FlashReg reduces correspondence-to-pose latency by 2--3x relative to TurboReg at comparable registration recall, while using about 50% of its peak allocated tensor memory on an embedded GPU. These results make FlashReg suitable as a high-throughput registration backend within onboard perception pipelines.

AI.tldr: FlashReg是一种面向GPU的点云配准方法，通过构建容量受限的稀疏二阶图和优化3-clique搜索，避免了密集评分二阶图的物化，实现了比TurboReg快2-3倍的对应关系到姿态估计延迟，同时内存占用减少约50%。
AI.motivation: 基于图形的点云配准通过识别几何一致的对应集实现了高鲁棒性，但构建二阶兼容性图和枚举候选团仍然是计算和内存密集型操作。

AI.result: 在室内外基准测试中，FlashReg在可比较的配准召回率下将对应关系到姿态的延迟降低2-3倍，同时在嵌入式GPU上仅使用约50%的峰值张量内存。
AI.conclusion: FlashReg适合作为机载感知流水线中的高吞吐量配准后端。

title: HIRA: A Human-in-the-Loop Retrieval-Augmented Cascade for Document Classification in Regulated Industries
summary:
Document classification in regulated industries is constrained by data residency, limited cold-start labels, scarce review capacity, and costly model-governance procedures. We present HIRA, a training-free, on-premises retrieval-augmented cascade for document classification in regulated deployments that combines BM25 over OCR text, dense text embeddings, and image-level representations through validation-calibrated weighted reciprocal-rank fusion. Confident documents are classified directly by retrieval; uncertain or visually confusable documents are passed to a locally hosted LLM verifier, which receives the OCR text, retrieved exemplars, label descriptions, and confusion-specific terms. When the verifier remains uncertain, the document is sent to human review. Each correction is stored as a margin-weighted retrieval exemplar and updates a Dirichlet-smoothed confusion graph, letting the system improve without updating model weights.
  On a private 80-class trade-finance corpus, HIRA processes the full 30,233-document production stream while requesting human correction for only 1,945 documents (6.4%), improving Macro-F1 from 0.6218 to 0.8548. On the corrected Tobacco-3482 benchmark, HIRA reaches 0.9423 Macro-F1 with a locally hosted DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B verifier, 17.4 percentage points above the zero-shot LLM baseline, while invoking the verifier for only about 40% of documents and reducing LLM calls by approximately 60%. With 518 human corrections (24.8% of the pool), HIRA matches the fully labelled pool oracle, in which all 2,086 pool documents are indexed with their ground-truth labels. These results show that selective human feedback and retrieval-memory adaptation can be a practical alternative to repeated model retraining for long-tail document classification in regulated deployments.

title: Through the Schrödinger Bridge: Benchmarking Antemortem Image Restoration from Postmortem Autolysis to Enhance Forensic Diagnostics
summary: Forensic histopathology, essential for determining cause of death and disease diagnosis, is severely impeded by postmortem autolysis, i.e., an irreversible, stochastic degradation process that distorts tissue morphology and introduces diagnostic subjectivity, thereby underscoring the value of restoring autolyzed images to a diagnostically plausible, pre-autolysis state for improving objectivity in forensic practice. This restoration task is fundamentally challenging due to the large, non-deterministic morphological changes caused by autolysis and the infeasibility of pixel-wise paired data, which invalidates assumptions underlying supervised and cycle/structure-consistent unpaired translation methods. To address this, we formalize forensic histopathology autolysis restoration as a new task: under unpaired supervision, transform postmortem images with severe autolysis into diagnostically meaningful ``antemortem'' representations. We contribute AutoPath, the first homologous yet unpaired dataset for this problem, constructed by splitting specimens into adjacent tissue blocks---one processed immediately, the other exposed to induce autolysis---yielding nearly ten thousand $10\times$ patches from 69 cases with varying liver conditions. We further frame the problem as a Schrödinger Bridge between the autolyzed and non-autolyzed distributions, offering a principled approach to modeling stochastic, severe morphological degradation. Critically, we demonstrate the misalignment of generic image-level generative metrics (e.g., FID) with diagnostic utility and propose a forensically grounded, slide-level diagnostic distribution consistency evaluation. Overall, this work establishes a reproducible benchmark (encompassing task definition, a real-world dataset, and an evaluation methodology) toward rigorous and practically meaningful progress in autolysis restoration for forensic pathology.

AI.method: 1)构建AutoPath同源未配对数据集：利用相邻组织块分别立即处理与暴露诱导自溶；2)将问题形式化为薛定谔桥问题，建模随机严重形态退化；3)提出幻灯片级诊断分布一致性评估，替代通用图像生成指标。

title: Hints, Critics, and Teachers: Prior Injection for Sparse-Reward RL in Vision-Language Math Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning for vision-language math reasoning starves under sparse reward: on a pool of 20,830 visual-math problems where Qwen2-VL-2B answers 3.6% of rollouts correctly, 85-97% of GRPO rollout groups are entirely wrong and contribute zero gradient. We train eleven methods under identical conditions in this regime, each injecting a different prior: text (reference-solution hints), distribution (on-policy distillation from a 7B teacher), and value (a value-pretrained critic with an MSE or HL-Gauss categorical loss). A prior helps exactly when it is delivered: the six arms whose prior effectively reaches the policy separate with no overlap from the remaining five -- the no-prior baseline and four arms whose prior is teacher-capped, gated away, or lost to a mis-parameterized critic -- both on the pooled in-domain metric and on cross-domain transfer (DynaMath). The central finding, however, concerns evaluation: one slice of the in-domain pool -- long used as this project's general-distribution check -- anti-correlates with genuine cross-domain transfer (Spearman rho = -0.74, n = 11 arms, permutation p = 0.011), while the hardest in-domain slice predicts it closely (rho = +0.89, p < 0.001). We attribute the inversion to a near-chance multiple-choice subset that rewards models for not having changed; read through it, the best cross-domain method looked mediocre and the worst looked like the champion. Among the methods, hint-guided exploration -- not UFT's auxiliary loss -- drives hint gains, and replacing the critic's MSE loss with HL-Gauss cross-entropy is worth +14.4 points in-domain. All accuracies are blind-judged, with paired exact tests.

title: PatchGate: Narrowing the Verbalization Gap with Intrinsic Object Inventories in Frozen Vision-Language Models
comment: 31 pages, 9 figures. Code will be available
summary: Reliable image captioning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires captions to be both precise and complete, avoiding unsupported object mentions while covering visible objects. Existing training-free methods primarily address the former requirement, suppressing unsupported object words by intervening on model-predicted mentions during generation. Because they operate only on objects the model is already likely to mention, visible objects omitted from the output remain difficult to recover. We propose PatchGate, a training-free framework that extracts prompt-free object evidence intrinsic to a frozen VLM before generation and uses it to narrow the gap between an intrinsic object set and final object mentions. In the first stage, Visual Evidence eXtraction (VEX) reads patch-level lexical evidence from the latter half of LM decoder layers and constructs an image-conditioned object set without any task prompt. In the second stage, Visual-Evidence Inclusion-Exclusion Decoding (VIED) uses this object evidence to calibrate decoding logits, promoting evidence-supported but under-verbalized objects and suppressing weakly supported but over-verbalized objects. On AMBER, PatchGate improves both sides of object-level reliability, increasing visible-object coverage from 49.4 to 56.0 (+13.4%) and reducing object hallucination by lowering CHAIR from 7.5 to 6.6 (-12.0%), without external detectors or fine-tuning and with one extra forward pass.

AI.tldr: PatchGate是一个无需训练的视觉语言模型可靠图像描述框架，通过从冻结VLM的解码器层中提取图像内在的对象证据，在生成过程中校准logits以同时提高对象覆盖率和减少对象幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有训练-free方法主要解决对象幻觉问题（抑制不支持的对象词），但对于遗漏可见对象的问题难以处理，因为它们只在模型已经可能提及的对象上操作。需要一种方法在生成前提取图像内在的对象证据。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 视觉证据提取(VEX)：从LM解码器后半层读取patch级词汇证据，构建无任务提示的图像条件对象集；2) 视觉证据包含-排除解码(VIED)：使用对象证据校准解码logits，提升有证据支持但被低估的对象，抑制弱支持但被高估的对象。
AI.result: 在AMBER数据集上，PatchGate将可见对象覆盖率从49.4%提升至56.0%（+13.4%），同时通过降低CHAIR从7.5至6.6减少对象幻觉12.0%，无需外部检测器或微调，仅需一次额外前向传播。
AI.conclusion: PatchGate成功实现了对象级可靠性两个维度的同时提升，证明了从冻结VLM中提取内在对象证据并用于校准解码的有效性，为训练-free VLM图像描述可靠性研究提供了新思路。

relevance_reason: The paper is about using VLM for image captioning and reducing object hallucination - this is Computer Vision, not Computer Graphics/3D motion generation. While it uses a Visual Language Model, it is NOT used for quality supervision of 3D motions, not for extracting 3D visual guidance features, and not for video generation (万相, Seedance). The application domain is completely different - it's about improving textual descriptions of images, not about generating 3D motions from video. This represents a fundamental mismatch in both application domain and research goal.

title: VisAdj: Learning Adjacency Matrices from Node-Link Images
summary: Learning adjacency matrices from node-link images is a fundamental problem for recovering structured graph information from visual observations. Existing methods typically rely on fixed KNN-based heuristics for candidate edge selection and fail to capture dependencies among edges. To overcome these limitations, we propose VisAdj, a new framework for topology-aware adjacency prediction. VisAdj introduces an attention-sparse neighbor sampler to adaptively select a high-recall set of candidate node pairs and performs joint edge inference using a line-graph transformer that treats candidate edges as tokens and explicitly models dependencies among incident edges. Extensive experiments on synthetic graphs, road networks, and vessel images demonstrate that VisAdj consistently outperforms existing baselines by clear margins.

AI.tldr: VisAdj是一个从节点链接图像中学习邻接矩阵的框架，通过注意力稀疏邻居采样器自适应选择高召回率的候选节点对，并使用线图变换器进行联合边推理，显式建模边之间的依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常依赖固定的KNN启发式算法选择候选边，无法捕获边之间的依赖关系，导致拓扑信息恢复不完整。
AI.method: 1. 引入注意力稀疏邻居采样器，自适应选择高召回率候选节点对；2. 使用线图变换器，将候选边作为token，显式建模相邻边之间的依赖关系进行联合推理。
AI.result: 在合成图、道路网络和船舶图像上的实验表明，VisAdj一致性地以明显优势优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: VisAdj通过自适应采样和拓扑感知的边依赖建模，有效提升了从视觉观测中恢复图结构信息的准确性和完整性。

relevance_reason: Completely irrelevant. This paper is about extracting adjacency matrices/topology from node-link images (graph structure recovery for road networks, synthetic graphs), which is entirely different from the research profile's focus on 3D motion generation from 2D video. The application domains are completely mismatched - one deals with graph topology extraction, the other deals with video-to-3D human motion generation. While both may use transformers, the purpose and domain are fundamentally different.

title: Towards Alias-Free 4D Gaussian Representations with Motion-Aware Filtering
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://maaf-4dgs.github.io/
summary: Novel-view synthesis of dynamic scenes, crucial for AR/VR applications, remains a challenging problem. Recent methods adapt representations like 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) for dynamic scenes by incorporating time as the fourth dimension (4D representations). These 4D representations still suffer from aliasing artifacts, especially when generating novel views from divergent viewpoints (zoom-in/zoom-out operations). While using 3D smoothing filters like those proposed in Mip-Splatting might seem like a possible solution, they fail to account for local motion and also exhibit aliasing. To address this, we propose a motion-aware 3D smoothing filter specifically designed for 4D representations. Our approach adapts the filter strength based on local motion information, effectively mitigating aliasing without compromising rendering quality. This is achieved by estimating the joint density function of time and focal-to-depth ratio using a non-parametric estimation method. During inference, we sample from this joint distribution to determine the appropriate smoothing filter. This flexible strategy can be integrated with various 4D representations. Our evaluations on standard datasets demonstrate superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 针对动态场景的新视图合成问题，提出了一种专为4D表示设计的运动感知3D平滑滤波器，通过基于局部运动信息自适应调整滤波器强度来有效减轻混叠伪影，同时不损害渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 动态场景的新视图合成在AR/VR应用中至关重要，但现有4D表示方法在生成分歧视角（缩放操作）的新视图时仍存在混叠问题，传统的3D平滑滤波器（如Mip-Splatting）无法处理局部运动且存在混叠。
AI.method: 提出运动感知3D平滑滤波器，通过非参数估计方法估计时间和焦距-深度比的联合密度函数，在推理时从该联合分布采样以确定适当的平滑滤波器强度，该策略可与各种4D表示集成。
AI.result: 在标准数据集上的评估表明，所提方法优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过自适应运动信息的灵活策略有效解决了4D表示中的混叠问题，具有良好的通用性和优越的性能。

relevance_reason: This paper addresses novel view synthesis for dynamic scenes using 4D Gaussian representations, which is a completely different application domain from the research profile focused on 3D motion generation from 2D video. While both are in computer graphics, the paper deals with view synthesis/AR-VR rendering issues (aliasing artifacts), not motion generation, feature extraction from video, or using video generation models. The methods (4D Gaussian splatting with motion-aware filtering) are unrelated to video generation models (万相, Seedance), VLM supervision, and 3D motion generation pipelines in the research profile.

title: Beyond Success and Failure: Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents powered by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown strong potential for automating tasks across diverse digital environments, where reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant training paradigm. However, widely used methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) suffer from reward-gradient misalignment, leading to inefficient and unstable optimization. Recent work addresses this issue by reformulating RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR) as contrastive or classification-based objectives, which improve stability by eliminating problematic gradient behaviors. Despite this progress, existing contrastive RLVR methods rely primarily on outcome-level supervision and fail to capture fine-grained differences in trajectory quality within the same outcome category. In this paper, we propose Length-Aware Contrastive Learning for GUI Agents (LACL-GUI), a contrastive RLVR framework that incorporates trajectory-level quality signals into policy optimization. LACL-GUI introduces structured preferences within both successful and failed trajectories, encouraging concise successful executions and differentiating failure quality based on divergence from successful trajectories, while preserving optimization stability. Experiments on GUI agent benchmarks show that LACL-GUI provides more effective learning signals and consistently improves agent performance over prior methods, highlighting the value of trajectory-level supervision in contrastive RLVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LACL-GUI框架，通过引入轨迹级质量信号来解决现有对比强化学习方法仅依赖结果级监督的问题。该方法在成功和失败轨迹内建立结构化偏好，鼓励简洁的成功执行，并根据与成功轨迹的差异区分失败质量，从而提升GUI代理的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有对比RLVR方法主要依赖结果级监督，无法捕捉同一结果类别内轨迹质量的细粒度差异。同时GRPO等方法存在奖励-梯度对齐问题，导致优化效率低下且不稳定。
AI.method: 提出LACL-GUI框架，包含三个核心组件：1）在成功轨迹内建立偏好，鼓励简洁执行；2）在失败轨迹中根据与成功轨迹的差异程度区分质量；3）保留对比学习的优化稳定性优势。
AI.result: 在GUI代理基准测试上的实验表明，LACL-GUI提供了更有效的学习信号，相比先前方法持续提升代理性能，验证了轨迹级监督在对比RLVR中的价值。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级质量信号的引入能够显著提升对比RLVR的效果，LACL-GUI为GUI代理的训练提供了一种更稳定有效的优化范式。

relevance_reason: Completely irrelevant. This paper is about GUI agents and reinforcement learning for improving AI agents that interact with graphical user interfaces. The research profile is about Computer Graphics focused on 3D motion generation from video, using video generation models, VLMs for quality supervision, and bridging 2D visual features to 3D motion space. These are entirely different application domains - GUI agent automation vs 3D computer graphics/motion generation. The methods, goals, and domains have no overlap.

title: Towards Bitstream-corrupted Harsh Visual Understanding: Through Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors
summary: Bitstream-corrupted Harsh Visual Understanding (BcHVU) aims to understand harshly degraded videos originally decoded from a severely corrupted bitstream in real-world multimedia communication. The ill-posed nature of BcHVU poses a major challenge for existing vision models, as even subtle bitstream corruption can lead to irreversible pixel distortion and significant semantic loss. To address these challenges in BcHVU, we propose Bitstream Language Modeling as Robust Semantic Priors (BLMSP), a framework for learning and injecting bitstream-native semantic cues. Our proposed BLMSP framework learns to extract bitstream-native semantic cues by bitstream language modeling, and leverages them as priors by injecting into off-the-shelf vision models of BcHVU tasks. Specifically, we present a Video Bitstream Byte Model (VBBM) that integrates byte-level modeling and cross-codec semantic distillation, enabling it to interpret robust semantics from byte sequences in multiple corrupted bitstream formats. The learned bitstream semantics are leveraged as robust priors and fused into BcHVU model backbones for improving the quality of video restoration, captioning, and human pose estimation. To train BLMSP, we construct a large-scale multi-source Corrupted-bitstream Harsh-video Paired (CHP) dataset containing 607k corrupted bitstream segments and 287k paired harsh video clips. Extensive experimental results show that the learned bitstream priors improve video restoration, captioning, and human pose estimation by 2.51 dB in PSNR, 0.20 in CIDEr, and 0.18 in PCK@0.2 on average, respectively. These results demonstrate that corrupted bitstream can serve as robust semantic priors in solving pixel distortion and semantic loss in BcHVU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BLMSP框架，通过比特流语言建模学习比特流原生语义线索，并将其作为先验注入到视频恢复、字幕和人体姿态估计任务中，解决比特流损坏视频的视觉理解问题。
AI.motivation: 比特流损坏导致视频出现像素失真和语义丢失，现有视觉模型难以处理这类退化严重的视频。BcHVU问题的病态性质对现有模型构成重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出VBBM视频比特流字节模型，集成字节级建模和跨编码器语义蒸馏，从多种损坏比特流格式的字节序列中提取鲁棒语义。将学习到的比特流语义作为先验融合到BcHVU模型骨干中。构建了包含607k损坏比特流片段和287k配对恶劣视频的大规模CHP数据集。
AI.result: 视频恢复PSNR提升2.51dB，字幕生成CIDEr提升0.20，人体姿态估计PCK@0.2提升0.18。
AI.conclusion: 损坏的比特流可作为鲁棒语义先验，有效解决BcHVU任务中的像素失真和语义丢失问题，为恶劣环境下视频理解提供了新思路。

relevance_reason: Complete mismatch in application domain. The research profile is about 3D motion generation from 2D video in Computer Graphics, while this paper is about bitstream-corrupted video understanding (video restoration, caption generation, pose estimation) in Computer Vision. Although the paper mentions human pose estimation, this is 2D pose estimation from corrupted video, NOT 3D motion generation. The methods (bitstream language modeling) are entirely different from the required methods (video generation models like 万相/Seedance for 3D motion generation). This paper addresses video degradation problems, not 3D motion synthesis or the bridge between 2D visual features and 3D motion space.

title: GameXpert-Bench: How Far Are Coding Agents from Expert Game Development?
summary: Recent large language models (LLMs) can operate as coding agents that build complete games from natural language requests. Game development is especially demanding because program logic, visual and audio content, interfaces, interaction and playability must function together in one executable artifact. Measuring this capability therefore requires evaluation of both game product and the development process. Existing benchmarks often assess the game development capabilities of LLMs by evaluating the final artifact or an isolated development stage. Our analysis of complete human-agent development trajectories identifies three stages that together span the lifecycle of game development with a coding agent: initial game generation, bug diagnosis and repair, and optimization over multiple turns. Therefore, we introduce GameXpert-Bench, which operationalizes the three lifecycle stages as three complementary benchmark tracks. GameGen evaluates complete game creation from a single request in an empty workspace. GameFix evaluates diagnosis and repair when defects are reported or left for the agent to discover. GameOpt evaluates cumulative optimization through request chains seeded by real development trajectories between users and agents. We evaluate each track using live game interaction, deterministic behavioral tests, or final product criteria with regression checks. The suite contains 97 generation tasks across 11 genres; 100 repair tasks from 50 game levels verified by humans, each with 19-27 injected bugs; and 17 optimization chains with six turns and 102 requests. Across the three tracks, current agents are more reliable at producing playable foundations and implementing explicit requirements than at discovering defects, verifying runtime behavior, and preserving functionality across changes.

AI.tldr: GameXpert-Bench是一个新的基准测试套件，通过三个轨道（GameGen生成、GameFix修复、GameOpt优化）全面评估大语言模型作为游戏开发编码代理的能力，包含97个生成任务、100个修复任务和17个优化链。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常通过评估最终产物或孤立开发阶段来评估LLM的游戏开发能力，但游戏开发需要在单个可执行文件中同时运行程序逻辑、视觉和音频内容、界面、交互和可玩性。因此需要评估游戏产品和开发过程两方面。
AI.method: 基准测试包含三个轨道：1) GameGen用于从单一请求在空工作区生成完整游戏；2) GameFix用于评估缺陷报告或代理自行发现缺陷时的诊断和修复；3) GameOpt用于评估基于用户与代理之间真实开发轨迹的请求链的累积优化。使用现场游戏交互、确定性行为测试或最终产品标准配合回归检查来评估每个轨道。
AI.result: 该套件包含97个跨11个类型的生成任务；100个来自50个游戏关卡的修复任务（经人工验证，每个关卡包含19-27个注入的bug）；以及17个包含6轮和102个请求的优化链。当前代理在生成可玩基础和实现明确需求方面更可靠，但在发现缺陷、验证运行时行为和跨更改保留功能方面表现较差。
AI.conclusion: GameXpert-Bench引入了一个全面的基准测试套件，由三个互补的轨道组成，用于评估LLM作为游戏开发编码代理的能力。当前代理在生成可玩基础和实现明确需求方面更可靠，但在发现缺陷、验证运行时行为和跨更改保留功能方面表现较差。

relevance_reason: This paper is about using LLMs as coding agents for game development tasks (GameGen, GameFix, GameOpt), which is a software engineering/AI agents domain. It is completely unrelated to the research profile which focuses on Computer Graphics for 3D motion generation from video, video generation models (万相, Seedance), VLM-based quality supervision, and bridging 2D visual features to 3D motion space. The application domains are entirely different - game development automation vs. 3D motion/video generation.

title: FIRM-Video: Check Before You Score for Reliable Text-to-Video Reward Modeling
summary: Reliable reward models are essential for text-to-video evaluation and alignment. However, the trade-off between evaluation accuracy and inference efficiency places high demands on the quality of training supervision. Existing approaches often rely on holistic judges with fixed rubrics or open-ended reasoning, leading to incomplete inspection, unfaithful justification, and entangled attribution. We introduce FIRM-Video, a unified checklist-driven data construction framework based on a check-before-score principle: construct dimension-specific checklists, verify each criterion against temporal visual evidence, and aggregate only verified decisions. For Instruction Following, FIRM-Video decomposes prompts into weighted atomic requirements; for World Coherence, it constructs prompt-calibrated, target-specific checks grounded in visible entities and actions; and for Perceptual Quality, it applies a generic taxonomy of visual defects. The verified criteria and scores are further transformed into natural-language analyses for end-to-end reward modeling. Subsequently, we construct FIRM-Video-90K with 88,044 dimension-specific instances from 29,348 videos, and introduce FIRM-Video-Bench with 750 point-wise human annotations across 250 videos. The Qwen3-VL-based FIRM-Video-8B achieves the best overall MAE on FIRM-Video-Bench while consistently delivering the highest VBench Total, Quality, and Semantic Scores in Best-of-8 sampling across three video generators.

AI.tldr: FIRM-Video是一个统一的多维度视频评估框架，采用"先验证后评分"原则，通过维度特定的检查清单、时序视觉证据验证和聚合验证决策来构建训练数据。该框架针对指令遵循、世界连贯性和感知质量三个维度分别设计评估方法，并构建了包含88,044个实例的数据集FIRM-Video-90K和750个人工标注的基准测试FIRM-Video-Bench。实验表明，基于Qwen3-VL的FIRM-Video-8B模型在MAE指标上达到最优，并在VBench各项评分中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 现有视频评估方法存在以下问题：1) 整体评判器使用固定评分标准导致检查不全面；2) 开放式推理产生不忠实论证；3) 评分归因混乱。同时面临评估准确性与推理效率之间的权衡困境。
AI.method: 提出FIRM-Video框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 指令遵循：将提示词分解为加权原子需求；2) 世界连贯性：构建基于可见实体和动作的提示校准目标检查；3) 感知质量：应用通用视觉缺陷分类体系。验证后的标准和分数转换为自然语言分析用于端到端奖励建模。
AI.result: FIRM-Video-8B在FIRM-Video-Bench上实现最佳MAE，并在三个视频生成器的Best-of-8采样中持续获得最高VBench总分、质量分和语义分。
AI.conclusion: 基于检查清单驱动的数据构建框架能有效提升视频评估的准确性和可解释性，为text-to-video对齐提供了高质量的训练监督信号。

relevance_reason: This paper is about VIDEO EVALUATION and REWARD MODELING for text-to-video generation, not about 3D motion generation from video features. While both involve video generation models and VLMs superficially, the application domains are completely different: the research profile targets extracting 3D visual guidance features from 2D video for 3D motion generation, while this paper focuses on assessing quality of generated videos (instruction following, world coherence, perceptual quality). This is a different task in a different subfield of computer graphics - video generation quality assessment vs. 3D motion generation from visual input.

title: LLM4LLM: Bridging Kernel Benchmarks and Real Deployment via Closed-Loop Agentic Optimization
summary: Large language models have become increasingly capable agents for low-level code and kernel optimization, but isolated kernel benchmarks provide only a proxy for the deployment behavior that matters in language-model inference. We identify a benchmark-to-deployment gap: candidate kernels that appear correct and fast in standalone harnesses can exhibit different performance, safety, or phase behavior after integration into a real inference workload. We introduce LLM4LLM, a deployment-aware closed-loop optimization framework that starts from a target inference script, extracts phase-aware optimization tasks, searches with an experience-guided episodic agent, and accepts patches through in-model validation. Across ten language-model inference workloads on A100 and H100 GPUs, LLM4LLM improves end-to-end latency for every evaluated model, achieving 3.91$\times$/6.98$\times$ geometric-mean speedups on A100/H100; as supporting kernel-level evidence, it also attains up to 2.745$\times$ GeoMean speedup on KernelBench Level 2.

AI.tldr: LLM4LLM是一个部署感知的闭环优化框架，用于解决语言模型推理中内核优化从基准测试到实际部署的差距问题。该框架从目标推理脚本出发，提取相位感知优化任务，通过经验引导的回合式智能体进行搜索，并通过模型内验证接受补丁。
AI.motivation: 论文识别了一个基准测试到部署的差距问题：在独立内核基准测试中表现正确和快速的候选内核，在集成到真实推理工作负载后可能表现出不同的性能、安全性或相位行为。传统的基准测试无法完全反映实际部署中的表现。
AI.method: LLM4LLM框架采用以下步骤：1)从目标推理脚本出发；2)提取相位感知的优化任务；3)使用经验引导的回合式智能体进行搜索；4)通过模型内验证接受补丁。该方法强调部署感知的闭环优化。
AI.result: 在A100和H100 GPU上的10个语言模型推理工作负载中，LLM4LLM在每个评估的模型上都提升了端到端延迟性能，实现了A100上3.91倍、H100上6.98倍的几何平均加速；在KernelBench Level 2上达到了最高2.745倍的几何平均加速。
AI.conclusion: LLM4LLM能够有效弥合基准测试与实际部署之间的性能差距，通过部署感知的闭环优化方法，在真实的语言模型推理场景中实现显著的性能提升。

relevance_reason: This paper is about LLM kernel optimization and GPU performance optimization for language model inference, which is completely unrelated to Computer Graphics and 3D motion generation. The application domain is systems/ML optimization, not computer graphics. It has no relevance to video generation models, 3D motion generation, or any of the pain points mentioned in the research profile.

title: BC-IHV: Conditioning the Color Space for Stable Rectified-Flow Low-Light Enhancement
summary: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) must correct ambiguous exposure without overwriting structure already supported by the input. Generative transport can model exposure ambiguity; however, its flexibility may also alter observable geometry and chromatic content. Moreover, fixed invertible color coordinates are usually treated only as representations, although their inverse mappings reshape the RGB-domain gradients received by the enhancement network. To address these issues, we propose Structure-Anchored Rectified Flow (SA-RF), which maintains correspondence through separate chromaticity/intensity stems, a scale-matched condition pyramid, and HybridAda. HybridAda assigns location-specific retrieval to spatial cross-attention and global exposure modulation to pooled AdaLN. We further introduce BC-IHV, a learnable Box--Cox polar color space whose analytically invertible intensity mapping controls the inverse-gradient dynamic range through a single exponent. This allows the representation to balance dark-range expansion and gradient conditioning instead of adopting a fixed linear or logarithmic law. Experiments on three LOL benchmarks, blind image-quality evaluation, and cross-dataset tests demonstrate consistent reconstruction and perceptual advantages over the sota. Controlled studies further support the effectiveness of both the proposed framework and color representation.

AI.tldr: SA-RF通过可学习的Box-Cox极坐标颜色空间和混合自适应模块，在保持图像结构的同时有效增强低光图像，解决曝光校正与结构保持之间的矛盾。
AI.motivation: 低光图像增强需要在不破坏已有结构的前提下修正模糊的曝光。现有的生成式传输方法虽能建模曝光不确定性，但会改变可观测的几何和色度内容。此外，固定的可逆颜色坐标通常仅作为表示使用，而未考虑其逆映射对RGB域梯度的重塑作用。

AI.result: 在三个LOL基准测试、盲图像质量评估和跨数据集测试中表现优异，重建一致性和感知质量均优于当前最先进方法。控制实验验证了框架和颜色表示的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SA-RF通过创新的颜色表示和网络设计，有效解决了低光图像增强中结构保持与曝光校正的矛盾，为该领域提供了新的技术路径。

title: AI Watchdog: Agent Interfaces for Detecting and Defending Against Manipulative Dark Patterns in AI Conversations
summary: Conversational AI increasingly shapes consequential decisions, yet users have limited support for recognizing and resisting manipulation. We present AI Watchdog, a browser-based agent interface that monitors live conversations, detects five dark-pattern categories, including sycophancy, brand bias, anthropomorphization, sneaking, and harmful generation, and alerts users when they occur. Its open-weight turn-level classifier supports independent deployment and a path toward local inference, preserving user privacy while remaining separate from the conversational AI. We evaluated AI Watchdog in a preregistered, five-condition between-subjects experiment (N = 150) comparing a no-intervention control with four configurations varying nudge timing (prebunking vs. just-in-time) and engagement mode (without vs. with cognitive forcing). Results show that participants rarely flagged manipulative turns across all conditions, and post-task awareness did not differ significantly across groups. However, just-in-time warnings without cognitive forcing were the only intervention to significantly reduce compliance with AI-steered recommendations containing dark patterns, lowering compliance from 71.7% to 53.7%, an 18 percentage-point reduction. Exploratory analyses further showed that lower misinformation susceptibility was associated with greater flagging but not lower compliance, while higher AI trust was associated with greater compliance and lower reported awareness. Together, these findings suggest that explicit recognition of conversational dark patterns and behavioral resistance to AI steering may be distinct outcomes, motivating further investigation of timely, low-friction defensive interfaces.

AI.tldr: AI Watchdog是一个浏览器代理接口，用于监控实时对话、检测五种黑暗模式类别（谄媚、品牌偏见、拟人化、潜入和有害生成），并在发生时向用户发出警报。研究通过150人的五组实验比较了不同干预时机和参与模式的效果，发现仅"即时警告无认知强制"的干预能显著将用户对包含黑暗模式的AI推荐遵从率从71.7%降低到53.7%。
AI.motivation: 对话AI越来越多地塑造关键决策，但用户缺乏识别和抵制操纵的支持。需要一种独立于对话AI的工具来检测黑暗模式并提醒用户。
AI.method: 在150名参与者中进行五条件组间实验，比较无干预控制组与四种干预配置（时机：预先防范vs即时；参与模式：无认知强制vs有认知强制）。使用开放权重的轮次级分类器检测五种黑暗模式类别。
AI.result: 各条件下参与者很少主动标记操纵性轮次，事后 awareness 无显著差异。但即时警告无认知强制是唯一显著减少黑暗模式AI推荐遵从率的干预（从71.7%降至53.7%，下降18个百分点）。较低的误导信息易感性与更多标记行为相关，但与较低遵从率无关；较高的AI信任度与更高遵从率和更低自我报告 awareness 相关。
AI.conclusion: 明确识别对话黑暗模式与行为抵制AI引导可能是不同结果，需要进一步研究及时、低摩擦的防御界面。即时、低摩擦的干预可能是减少黑暗模式影响的有效策略。

title: GaussVid: Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting with 3D-Aware Video Diffusion Priors
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has achieved remarkable success in novel view synthesis; however, reconstructions under sparse views often exhibit noticeable artifacts. While recent video diffusion models provide strong spatio-temporal priors for 3DGS restoration, directly fine-tuning them for restoration is suboptimal, as they lack awareness of the underlying multi-camera geometry, resulting in multi-view inconsistencies. In this work, we propose a novel 3D-aware video restoration framework designed to enhance the quality of sparse 3DGS reconstruction. Specifically, we construct a large-scale 3DGS video dataset to enable specialized fine-tuning. To bridge the gap between 2D video generation and 3D multi-view constraints, we introduce a camera-conditioned geometric prior. By using the first and last frames as boundary anchors and encoding the corresponding camera relationships, we explicitly inject spatial structure into the video generation pipeline. This boundary-anchored, camera-aware prior guides the network toward geometrically grounded restoration that remains coherent across viewpoints. Extensive experiments show that, among video-prior restoration methods, our approach attains the best pixel- and structure-level fidelity (PSNR/SSIM) and improves multi-view consistency, while remaining competitive in perceptual quality (LPIPS).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新颖的3D感知视频恢复框架，用于提升稀疏视角下3D Gaussian Splatting重建质量。通过构建大规模3DGS视频数据集并进行针对性微调，同时引入边界锚定的相机感知先验，将多相机几何约束注入视频生成 pipeline。
AI.motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 在新视角合成中取得显著成功，但稀疏视角下的重建结果常出现明显伪影。尽管近期视频扩散模型提供了强大的时空先验，但直接用于3DGS恢复效果欠佳，因为这些模型缺乏对底层多相机几何结构的感知，导致多视角不一致性问题。
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模3DGS视频数据集以支持专项微调；2) 引入边界锚定的相机感知几何先验，以首帧和末帧作为边界锚点，编码对应相机关系，将空间结构显式注入视频生成流程。
AI.result: 在视频先验恢复方法中取得最佳像素级和结构级保真度(PSNR/SSIM)，显著提升多视角一致性，感知质量(LPIPS)也具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架通过相机条件几何先验有效弥合了2D视频生成与3D多视角约束之间的鸿沟，实现了几何一致且多视角连贯的3DGS重建恢复。

relevance_reason: The paper is about 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction for novel view synthesis (scene/object reconstruction), NOT 3D human motion generation. Although both use video diffusion models, the application domain is completely different: the research profile targets extracting and generating 3D human MOTION from video for character animation, while GaussVid targets reconstructing 3D SCENES from sparse viewpoints. The pain points, goals, and outputs are fundamentally different - this is scene reconstruction vs motion generation.

title: MemGuard: Persisting Verifier Signals for LLM-Agent Memory Governance
summary: LLM agents are moving from single-prompt use to long task streams in which reusable memory becomes a core capability for terminal, software-engineering, and web tasks. Such memory is useful only when stored experience remains reliable across hundreds of interactions, but two failure modes break that assumption in practice. The first is unreliable admission: failed trajectories,accidental successes, and misleading observations enter memory because they appear relevant, then mislead later decisions. The second is memory drift: long-running banks accumulate duplicate, stale, and conflicting records that retrieval alone cannot repair. MemGuard's key distinction is to treat verifier output not as a one-shot filter, but as persistent lifecycle metadata. It converts multi-criteria score-token verification into reward, confidence, label, and uncertainty descriptors that are attached to every candidate before activation and reused during retrieval, conflict resolution, summarization, and archival. We evaluate MemGuard on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-Bench Verified, WebArena, and Mind2Web across four backbones, comparing against four memory baselines plus a verifier-only control under matched runtime budgets. Averaged over five seeds, MemGuard achieves the best success metric and lowest average steps in all 16 backbone-benchmark settings, improving over ReasoningBank, the strongest prior baseline among the memory methods we evaluate, with a largest gain of 7.9 success-rate points on WebArena, 5.6 step-success-rate points on Mind2Web, and 2.4-3.5 points on terminal and software-engineering benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/whyyyyy123/MemGuard.

AI.tldr: MemGuard是一种新型LLM代理内存系统，通过将验证器输出转化为持久生命周期元数据（奖励、置信度、标签和不确定性描述符），有效解决了现有内存系统面临的两个核心失败模式：不可靠的 admission（失败轨迹和误导性观察进入内存）和内存漂移（重复、陈旧、冲突记录）。
AI.motivation: LLM代理正从单提示使用转向长任务流，可重用内存成为核心能力。然而，现有内存系统在数百次交互中会失效，原因包括：(1)不可靠的admission：失败轨迹、偶然成功和误导性观察因看似相关而进入内存，进而误导后续决策；(2)内存漂移：长期运行的内存积累重复、陈旧和冲突的记录，仅靠检索无法修复。
AI.method: MemGuard的核心创新在于将验证器输出视为持久生命周期元数据而非一次性过滤器。具体包括：(1)将多标准分数-标记验证转化为奖励、置信度、标签和不确定性描述符；(2)这些元数据在激活前附加到每个候选记忆，并在检索、冲突解决、总结和归档过程中重复使用。评估在Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-Bench Verified、WebArena和Mind2Web四个基准上测试了四种骨干模型，与四个内存基线加上验证器单独控制进行对比，在相同运行预算下进行。
AI.result: 在五个种子的平均结果中，MemGuard在所有16种骨干-基准设置中均取得最佳成功率和最低平均步数。相比最强内存基线ReasoningBank，MemGuard在WebArena上提升7.9个成功率点，在Mind2Web上提升5.6个步数-成功率点，在终端和软件工程基准上提升2.4-3.5个点。
AI.conclusion: MemGuard通过将验证器输出转化为持久生命周期元数据，有效解决了LLM代理内存系统中的admission可靠性和内存漂移两大难题，在多种基准测试和骨干模型上均取得了显著的性能提升，为构建可靠的长期运行LLM代理系统提供了新的解决方案。

It addresses LLM agent memory issues (admission control, memory drift) - not 3D visual feature extraction, video generation models, or motion generation. The application domain is entirely different (AI agents vs computer graphics).

title: Frame-Level Evaluation in Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection Mostly Measures Video-Level Ranking
summary: Weakly supervised video anomaly detectors are trained with video-level labels but are commonly evaluated as temporal localizers using Micro-AUROC or AP over pooled test frames. Because these metrics compare frames from different videos, a detector can score well by separating videos without accurately ordering moments within them. We exactly decompose Micro-AUROC by video identity into Within-AUROC for temporal ordering within videos and Cross-AUROC for comparisons across videos. Across ShanghaiTech, XD-Violence, and UCF-Crime, only 0.071-0.388% of comparisons between anomalous and normal frames occur within the same video. When both classes remain distributed across V videos, this share decreases as O(1/V), a benchmark property we call temporal dilution. We train anomaly video binary classifiers under the same video-level supervision and repeat each video score across all frames. These video-constant outputs reach 81.40-97.18 Micro-AUROC despite having no within-video variation. Across 72 controlled runs, replacing every frame score with its video mean preserves a median 98.6% of the Micro-AUROC margin above chance. The same empirical pattern holds for author-released outputs and for XD-Violence under its official AP evaluation. A detector can therefore achieve a high pooled score even when it assigns the same score to every moment within each video.

AI.tldr: 当前弱监督视频异常检测的评估指标（Micro-AUROC/AP）存在严重问题：检测器可以通过简单地分离不同视频来获得高分，而不需要准确识别视频内的异常时刻。论文证明了即使给每个视频的所有帧分配相同的分数，也能达到81-97%的Micro-AUROC，这揭示了评估指标的本质缺陷。
AI.motivation: 弱监督视频异常检测器使用视频级标签训练，但用帧级别的Micro-AUROC或AP评估。作者发现这些指标比较不同视频的帧，导致检测器可以通过分离不同视频获得高分，而不需要准确排序视频内的异常时刻。这促使作者研究评估指标的有效性。
AI.method: 1. 将Micro-AUROC分解为Within-AUROC（视频内时间排序）和Cross-AUROC（跨视频比较）；2. 在三个数据集上计算同一视频内异常-正常帧对的比例；3. 训练视频级二分类器并将视频分数重复到所有帧，测试其性能；4. 进行72次控制运行实验验证。
AI.result: 1. 在ShanghaiTech、XD-Violence和UCF-Crime数据集上，只有0.071-0.388%的比较发生在同一视频内；2. 视频常数输出（无视频内变化）达到81.40-97.18 Micro-AUROC；3. 用视频均值替换帧分数保留中位数98.6%的AUROC边际；4. 作者发布的输出和XD-Violence的AP评估也呈现相同模式。
AI.conclusion: 当前评估指标存在"时间稀释"问题，允许检测器在不对视频内时刻进行任何排序的情况下获得高分。评估方法需要改革，建议使用视频内评估或改进的指标来真正衡量时间定位能力。

title: HiMA-MDD: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Harness for Interpretable Multimodal Depression Detection in Clinical Interviews
summary: Depression assessment from multimodal clinical interviews requires integrating dispersed evidence from multiple symptoms into a coherent PHQ-8 profile. This process is hierarchical: relevant evidence is often sparse and context-dependent within local question-answer exchanges, multiple exchanges jointly support symptom-level judgments, and the final assessment depends on the coherence of the complete symptom profile. Existing LLM systems either process interviews holistically or distribute work across generic agent roles; neither design necessarily provides an explicit orchestration mechanism that coordinates evidence access, item-score authority, bounded feedback, and state recording across these levels. To address this gap, we introduce HiMA-MDD, a hierarchical multi-agent harness that aligns this assessment hierarchy with three agent layers. After non-agentic preprocessing constructs context-preserving multimodal QA units, Layer 1 identifies candidate QA-to-item relations and supports bounded item-grounded evidence routing. Layer 2 assigns symptom groups to operational factor specialists, with one specialist responsible for each provisional item score. Layer 3 audits the complete provisional profile, requests at most one round of targeted revision, and reconstructs the verified PHQ-8 profile. This layered design naturally yields a Hierarchical Evidence Trace, preserves all intermediate evidence, judgments, and revisions for auditability. The final item scores then deterministically produce the total score and screening decision. Using Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct as the harness backbone, our experiments on E-DAIC demonstrate that HiMA-MDD outperforms the compared state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: HiMA-MDD是一种用于抑郁症评估的分层多智能体系统，通过三层智能体架构将多模态临床访谈整合为PHQ-8评分档案，解决现有LLM系统缺乏明确协调机制的问题。
AI.motivation: 抑郁症多模态临床访谈评估需要将分散在多个症状中的证据整合为连贯的PHQ-8档案。这一过程具有层次性：相关证据通常在本地问答交流中稀疏且依赖上下文，多个交流共同支持症状级判断，最终评估取决于完整症状档案的一致性。现有LLM系统要么整体处理访谈，要么在通用智能体角色间分配工作，均未提供明确的协调机制来协调证据访问、项目评分权限、有限反馈和跨层次状态记录。
AI.method: 提出三层智能体层次结构：1）非智能体预处理构建保留上下文的 multimodal QA单元，Layer 1识别候选QA到项目关系并支持基于项目的证据路由；2）Layer 2将症状组分配给操作因子专家，每个专家负责一个临时项目评分；3）Layer 3审计完整临时档案，最多请求一轮针对性修订，重建已验证的PHQ-8档案。使用Qwen2.72B-Instruct作为框架主干。
AI.result: 在E-DAIC数据集上的实验表明，HiMA-MDD优于对比的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 分层设计自然产生分层证据追踪，保留所有中间证据、判断和修订以供审计。最终项目评分确定性生成总分和筛查决策。该架构有效解决了临床抑郁症评估中证据整合和层次化推理的问题。

title: GuardPaint:SpeculativeSafetyDecodingforText-to-ImageGeneration
summary:
Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models offer powerful visual generation, but their controllability creates a critical safety challenge: adversarial prompts can steer the denoising trajectory toward policy-violating content such as explicit nudity or graphic violence. Existing safeguards mostly act before generation through prompt filtering or after generation through image classification, leaving the diffusion process itself unguarded and often yielding only refusal rather than safe visual repair.
  We introduce GuardPaint, a speculative decoding framework for safe T2I generation that intervenes inside the diffusion trajectory without modifying the base model. A lightweight auditor monitors intermediate images, localizes unsafe regions, and triggers surgical inpainting repair only where needed. Candidate repairs are generated by a policy-aligned inpainter and selected through a guarded tournament that accepts edits only when they improve policy compliance while preserving prompt fidelity and perceptual quality.
  Across five jailbreak families SneakPrompt, MMA, PGJ, DACA, and RABell and UNet/flow-matching models including SD~1.5, SDXL, SD~3.5, and FLUX.1-dev. GuardPaint reduces attack success and harmful generations with minimal degradation to image quality, prompt fidelity, and benign behavior.
  Content warning: This paper contains examples involving nudity and violence that some readers may find disturbing, distressing, or offensive.

AI.tldr: GuardPaint是一种针对文本到图像(T2I)扩散模型的安全生成框架,通过在去噪轨迹内部进行干预来防御对抗性提示攻击,而无需修改基础模型。该框架使用轻量级审计器监控中间图像,定位不安全区域,并仅在需要时触发外科修复式inpainting,通过守卫锦标赛选择修复方案。实验表明该方法在多种越狱攻击和扩散模型上显著降低攻击成功率,同时保持图像质量和提示保真度。
AI.motivation: 当前的T2I扩散模型安全防护主要在生成前通过提示过滤或生成后通过图像分类进行,存在两个主要问题:1)扩散过程本身缺乏防护,2)现有方法通常只是简单拒绝生成而非安全修复。 adversarial prompts可以操纵去噪轨迹生成违规内容(如明确裸体或 graphic violence),需要一个能在生成过程中实时干预的解决方案。
AI.method: GuardPaint采用 speculative decoding框架:1)轻量级审计器监控中间图像,定位不安全区域;2)触发策略对齐的inpainter进行外科修复;3)通过守卫锦标赛选择修复方案,仅在提升策略合规性同时保持提示保真度和感知质量时接受编辑。方法不修改基础模型,通过后处理方式实现安全干预。
AI.result: 在5个越狱攻击家族(SneakPrompt, MMA, PGJ, DACA, RABell)和多种UNet/flow-matching模型(SD 1.5, SDXL, SD 3.5, FLUX.1-dev)上,GuardPaint显著降低攻击成功率和有害生成,同时对图像质量、提示保真度和良性行为的影响最小。
AI.conclusion: GuardPaint提供了一种在扩散轨迹内部进行安全干预的有效范式,无需修改基础模型即可实现 surgical inpainting repair。该框架在多种攻击和模型上展现有效性,为T2I模型安全提供了新思路,同时平衡了安全合规与生成质量。

The paper is about text-to-image generation safety (defending against adversarial prompts in 2D image generation), while the research profile is about 3D MOTION generation from 2D video features. The application domains are fundamentally different: 2D image generation vs 3D motion generation. Although both use diffusion models, they are applied to completely different tasks. The pain points (3D motion quality, 2D-to-3D feature extraction) have no connection to image generation safety/auditing.

title: From Solver Feedback to Faithful Plans: Multi-Role Reinforcement Learning for Symbolic Planning
summary: Reliable planning requires converting natural-language instructions into executable symbolic specifications, yet large language models remain brittle without costly PDDL annotations and may exploit solver success in semantically unfaithful ways. We study how to learn faithful natural-language-to-PDDL formalization using only solver feedback, without human-written demonstrations. We propose a solvergrounded multi-role reinforcement learning framework where a single language model acts as an Actor, Judge, and Editor for generation, verification, and repair. The Actor proposes PDDL specifications, the Judge provides a solver-calibrated quality signal, and the Editor performs bounded diagnostic-conditioned refinement. On PlanBench, our method improves average success from 35.5% for LLM+P to 70.8%, achieves 66.3% faithful success, and reduces semantic drift to 6.4%. These results show that organizing solver feedback into generation, verification, and repair roles enables more scalable and faithful annotation-free symbolic planning

AI.tldr: 研究如何仅通过求解器反馈学习忠实于自然语言的PDDL形式化，而无需人工标注。提出一种求解器 grounding 的多角色强化学习框架，让单个语言模型同时扮演Actor、Judge和Editor三种角色，分别负责生成、验证和修复PDDL规范。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在将自然语言指令转换为可执行的符号规范时仍然脆弱，需要昂贵的PDDL标注，且可能以语义不忠实的方式利用求解器成功。需要一种无需人工演示、仅依靠求解器反馈的学习方法。
AI.method: 提出求解器 grounding 的多角色强化学习框架：Actor负责提出PDDL规范，Judge提供求解器校准的质量信号，Editor执行有界诊断条件下的修复。在PlanBench数据集上进行了实验。

AI.conclusion: 将求解器反馈组织成生成、验证和修复角色能够实现更可扩展且忠实于语义的符号规划，无需人工标注即可显著提升LLM的规划能力。

The research profile focuses on video-to-3D motion generation, visual feature extraction, and video generation models. This paper addresses LLM-based planning tasks with RL roles (Actor/Judge/Editor) for PDDL generation - a totally different application domain (AI planning/symbolic reasoning) than computer graphics and 3D motion generation.

title: ViSMoE: Visual-Aware Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Embodied Referring Expression Grounding
summary: Embodied Referring Expression Grounding is the task of enabling an agent to navigate in real environments and to localize a remote object based on natural language instructions. In this scenario, the agent needs to select one view for navigation at each step and identify a specific object among all candidate objects at the destination. However, most of the previous approaches fail to distinguish between views and objects, instead processing them using the vanilla vision encoder, which results in ambiguous representations of both views and objects. To address the above issues, we propose ViSMoE, which equips sparse Mixture-of-Experts with a visual-aware routing policy for the embodied agent. This framework processes different types of visual information specifically, resulting in discriminative visual representations for both views and objects. Experimental results on REVERIE and SOON datasets demonstrate that ViSMoE outperforms the previous state-of-the-art methods, showing the superiority of our proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ViSMoE框架，通过稀疏专家混合系统和视觉感知路由策略处理具身智能体在不同视图中的视觉信息，以解决具身引用表达定位任务中视图和对象表示模糊的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法区分视图和对象，使用普通视觉编码器导致两者的表示模糊，这影响了智能体在真实环境中根据自然语言指令定位目标对象的能力。
AI.method: 提出ViSMoE框架，将稀疏专家混合系统与视觉感知路由策略相结合，使智能体能够针对不同类型的视觉信息（视图和对象）使用专门的专家处理，从而生成更具判别性的视觉表示。
AI.result: 在REVERIE和SOON数据集上的实验表明，ViSMoE优于先前最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉感知的路由策略专门处理不同类型的视觉信息，可以有效提升具身引用表达定位任务的表现，生成的判别性视觉表示对导航和目标定位至关重要。

relevance_reason: Completely different application domain. This paper is about embodied AI/robot navigation for visual grounding (helping agents locate objects based on language instructions), while the research profile is about Computer Graphics - specifically 3D motion generation from video using video generation models. The methods are also different: this paper uses Mixture-of-Experts for view/object discrimination, not video generation models like diffusion for motion synthesis. Robot navigation is a completely different field from 3D motion generation.

title: Training Needs Trustworthy Worlds: Verified Synthetic Web Environments for Agent Learning
summary: Web agents promise to automate complex digital workflows, but their training remains limited by synthetic environments that look plausible while hiding broken links, inconsistent states, or infeasible tasks. We address the gap between scalable environment generation and trustworthy agent learning by constructing synthetic web environments that are executable, auditable, and grounded in backend state. Our framework represents each generated website as a structured scaffold of pages, navigation links, database records, state-change markers, and task constraints, then verifies and repairs structural, semantic, consistency, and feasibility defects before policy training. During interaction, ordinary UI transitions are executed deterministically, while persistent backend updates are invoked only through validated state-change markers, enabling dense rewards compiled from verified task-progress predicates. Across 500 synthetic environments spanning six domains, our method reduces task-blocking defects and improves feasible-task rate from 48.6% to 94.8%, while producing stronger PPO policies and improving transfer to WebArena, WebShop, and MiniWoB++ without LLM calls at evaluation time. These results show that verified synthetic environments can serve as a scalable and reliable training substrate for compact web agents, shifting synthetic webagent learning from surface-level plausibility toward executable, state-grounded supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可验证的合成网页环境构建框架，通过结构化脚手架表示、缺陷修复和状态验证，提升网页智能体训练质量。实验表明该方法将可行任务率从48.6%提升至94.8%，并改善了策略迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 当前网页智能体的训练依赖于合成环境，但这些环境存在表面可信但实际包含断链、状态不一致或不可行任务的缺陷，导致训练效果与真实部署存在显著差距。
AI.method: 框架将每个生成的网站表示为结构化脚手架，包含页面、导航链接、数据库记录、状态变更标记和任务约束；在策略训练前验证并修复结构、语义、一致性和可行性缺陷；交互时通过验证的状态变更标记执行后端更新，基于验证的任务进度谓词编译奖励信号。
AI.result: 在500个覆盖六个领域的合成环境中，方法将任务阻断缺陷从48.6%降至5.2%（可行任务率提升至94.8%），生成更强的PPO策略，并在WebArena、WebShop和MiniWoB++上实现更好的迁移效果，且评估时无需调用LLM。
AI.conclusion: 验证后的合成环境可作为紧凑网页智能体可扩展且可靠的训练基座，推动合成网页智能体学习从表面可信度向可执行、状态可验证的监督范式转变。

relevance_reason: This paper is about building verifiable synthetic web environments for training web agents, which is completely unrelated to Computer Graphics and 3D motion generation. The application domain is entirely different (web development/AI agents vs. graphics/motion synthesis). The methods used (structured scaffold representations, defect repair, state verification for web pages) have no relevance to the research profile's focus on video generation models, VLM supervision, 3D motion generation, or feature extraction pipelines for 2D-to-3D conversion.

title: Region-Weighted Losses and Model Fusion for Cross-Modal PET Attenuation Correction
comment: ntkhoa team submission for BIC-MAC MICCAI26 challenge (https://www.codabench.org/competitions/12555/#/results-tab)
summary: We describe our approach to the Big Cross-Modal Attenuation Correction (BIC-MAC) challenge, which asks for a pseudo-CT in Hounsfield Units to be synthesized from Non-Attenuation-Corrected PET (NAC-PET), DIXON MRI and a topogram, and scores both the pseudo-CT and the Attenuation-Corrected PET (AC-PET) reconstructed from it. Three ideas carried our improvements over the organizers' 3D U-Net baseline. The loss matters more than the architecture: we compute the $L_1$ error in the Carney attenuation-coefficient ($μ$) space that the CT metric itself uses, weighted by anatomical region. Only once that loss was in place did the unregistered DIXON MRI work as extra input channels. A fixed convex combination of two independently trained models then beat both of its members on three of the four metrics and ranks first overall on the public validation leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了BIC-MAC挑战赛的方法，该挑战赛要求从非衰减校正PET、DIXON MRI和topogram合成伪CT，并评估伪CT和由其重建的衰减校正PET。作者提出三个改进：1) 使用Carney attenuation-coefficient (μ)空间的L1损失函数，按解剖区域加权；2) 将未配准的DIXON MRI作为额外输入通道；3) 使用两个独立训练模型的固定凸组合。该方法在公开验证排行榜上排名第一。
AI.motivation: BIC-MAC挑战赛需要从NAC-PET、DIXON MRI和topogram合成伪CT，用于衰减校正PET重建。现有方法（如3D U-Net基线）效果不佳，需要改进。
AI.method: 1. 损失函数改进：在Carney attenuation-coefficient (μ)空间计算L1误差，按解剖区域加权；2. 输入改进：加入未配准的DIXON MRI作为额外输入通道；3. 模型集成：固定凸组合两个独立训练模型。
AI.result: 该方法在三个指标上超越两个独立模型，在公开验证排行榜上排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 损失函数的选择比架构本身更重要；在损失函数改进后，未配准的DIXON MRI才能作为有效输入；模型集成能进一步提升性能。

relevance_reason: This paper is about medical imaging (PET attenuation correction for cancer diagnosis) - completely different application domain from Computer Graphics and 3D motion generation. Even though both use deep learning/neural networks, the research profile focuses on video-to-3D-motion generation using video generation models and VLM supervision, while this paper focuses on synthesizing pseudo-CT from PET and MRI scans for medical purposes. The goals, inputs, outputs, and domain expertise are entirely different.

title: Consistency Is Not Coherence: Orientation Search for Certified Alignments Between 4D Defence Upper Ontologies
comment: 14 pages. Long paper accepted at the Ontology Matching 2026 workshop (OM 2026), co-located with ISWC 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/fabio-rovai/ies-hqdm-crosswalk
summary: We align three upper ontologies that sit under UK and NATO defence data infrastructure: the Information Exchange Standard (IES), the Higher Quality Data Model (HQDM) that underpins the National Digital Twin, and Basic Formal Ontology (BFO). No public alignment between IES and HQDM existed. Promoting a hand-curated 17-correspondence crosswalk to OWL and reasoning over the complete merged ontologies with HermiT produces three results that we believe matter beyond this pair.

AI.tldr: 将UK和NATO防御数据基础设施下的三个上层本体（IES、HQDM、BFO）进行对齐，构建17-对应关系的OWL交叉映射，并使用HermiT推理器进行推理验证。
AI.motivation: IES和HQDM之间不存在公共对齐，而两者都是国防数据基础设施的核心上层本体，需要创建对齐以支持防御数据的互操作性和集成。
AI.method: 将手工创建的17个对应关系转换为OWL格式，使用HermiT推理器对完整合并的本体进行推理，验证对齐的一致性和有效性。
AI.result: 生成了三个具有更广泛适用性的重要结果，这些结果超出了IES和HQDM这一对本体的范围。
AI.conclusion: 通过将手工交叉walk提升为形式化OWL并应用自动推理，成功实现了三个上层本体的对齐，为国防数据基础设施的互操作性提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression
summary: Multimodal large reasoning models often rely on long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces in which a substantial fraction of tokens, such as repeated visual descriptions, self-reflection, and other visually-disengaged filler, inflate inference cost without contributing to the answer. Existing CoT compression methods optimize output length but never measure whether a reasoning token is actually grounded in the image. We propose \textbf{VIG} (Visual Information Gain), an information-theoretic GRPO reward that scores each reasoning token by how much the image reduces its predictive uncertainty. VIG is computed online from two forward passes of the same policy, one with and one without the image, so no reference chains, external annotations, or auxiliary reward models are needed. Across six main multimodal reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3-VL-Thinking model sizes (2B/4B/8B), plus an additional R1-Onevision-Bench evaluation on 8B, VIG consistently improves the accuracy--efficiency trade-off, supporting our central claim: \emph{efficient multimodal reasoning emerges from raising visual information density, where every reasoning token earns its place by anchoring to the image, rather than from imposing a length budget.} Our source code is available at https://github.com/chaser682/vig.

AI.tldr: VIG（视觉信息增益）是一种信息论GRPO奖励机制，通过比较模型带图和不带图两次前向传播的预测不确定性差异来评估每个推理token的视觉信息密度，从而在不依赖外部注释或奖励模型的情况下，实现多模态大语言模型的高效推理。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大推理模型依赖冗长的思维链（CoT），其中大量token（如重复的视觉描述、自我反思等）与图像无关却消耗计算资源。现有CoT压缩方法仅优化输出长度，未评估推理token是否真正基于图像。
AI.method: 提出VIG（Visual Information Gain）：对同一策略进行两次前向传播（分别输入图像和不输入图像），计算图像对预测不确定性的减少量，以此作为每个推理token的奖励分数。该方法无需参考链、外部标注或辅助奖励模型。
AI.result: 在6个多模态推理基准和3个Qwen3-VL-Thinking模型规模（2B/4B/8B）上，以及R1-Onevision-Bench的8B评估中，VIG一致性地改善了准确率-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 高效的多模态推理源于提升视觉信息密度（每个推理token锚定图像），而非施加长度预算。这一方法为多模态推理的效率优化提供了新范式。

relevance_reason: This paper is about multimodal LLM reasoning and CoT compression using information theory - it's in the NLP/ML domain, not Computer Graphics. While it involves visual understanding, it has nothing to do with 3D motion generation, extracting visual features from video for 3D reconstruction, or the video generation models (万相, Seedance) mentioned in the research profile. The application domain is completely different - this is about improving LLM efficiency through visual information gain measurement, not about 3D visual guidance features or motion generation.

title: ESCRAG-R1: Retrieval-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Emotional Support Conversation
summary: Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) systems aim to provide holistic support by balancing professional therapeutic competence with natural empathy. However, existing methods struggle to simultaneously achieve structured, stage-aware reasoning and seamless empathy-expertise alignment, often resulting in an artificial splicing of clinical strategies and generic reassurance. To overcome these limitations, we propose ESCRAG-R1, a unified framework that integrates retrieval-based psychological guidance into Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). By incorporating retrieval into the reinforcement learning loop, ESCRAG-R1 transforms external knowledge into a robust learning signal that stimulates explicit internal reasoning prior to generation and fundamentally reshapes the model's internal policy. To provide the reliable supervision required for this optimization, we construct ESC-Preference, a high-quality dataset based on a Client--Counselor--Judge evaluation framework that delivers precise, empathy-aware reward signals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ESCRAG-R1 significantly outperforms existing baselines by mitigating superficial splicing and realizing a natural integration of professional guidance and empathetic expression. Code and datasets are released at https://github.com/Matcha-Liu/ESCRAG-R1.

AI.tldr: ESCRAG-R1通过将检索增强的心理指导集成到GRPO强化学习框架中，解决了情感支持对话系统中专业知识与同理心难以自然融合的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有ESC系统难以同时实现结构化、阶段感知推理和同理心-专业知识无缝对齐，导致临床策略和通用安慰的人工拼接。
AI.method: 提出ESCRAG-R1框架，将基于检索的心理指导集成到Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)中，将外部知识转化为学习信号刺激生成前的显式内部推理；构建ESC-Preference数据集，基于Client-Counselor-Judge评估框架。
AI.result: 显著优于现有基线，减轻了表面拼接，实现了专业指导和情感表达的自然整合。
AI.conclusion: ESCRAG-R1能有效实现专业心理指导和情感表达的自然整合，为情感支持对话系统的设计提供了新思路。

This paper is about Emotional Support Conversation systems using retrieval-augmented reinforcement learning in NLP, while the research profile is about Computer Graphics focused on 3D motion generation from video using video generation models and VLMs. There is no overlap in application domain (dialogue systems vs 3D motion generation), methods (GRPO/RAG vs video generation models), or research field (NLP vs Computer Graphics).

title: Pixel-Space Diffusion via Observation Operators
summary: Pixel-space diffusion models directly model image distributions but remain difficult to optimize. Recent methods alleviate this challenge through target reparameterization, while still relying on a fixed clean-image target throughout denoising. Through empirical analysis, we identify a scale-time mismatch: image structures become predictable from coarse to fine as noise decreases, whereas existing models are forced to predict the full image even under high noise, resulting in low-SNR gradients that hinder optimization. To resolve this mismatch, we propose Observation Operator Diffusion, a unified framework that aligns both the supervision trajectory and feature refinement with the intrinsic recovery order of image structures. Specifically, we replace fixed full-image supervision along the standard flow path with a time-indexed observation trajectory that evolves from coarse structures to the full image during denoising. This trajectory is instantiated with a family of Gaussian-Lanczos operators at varying observation scales, yielding a path-consistent training objective. We further introduce GL-CoDA, a decoder that injects scale-specific Gaussian-Lanczos observations across decoding stages for coarse-to-fine feature refinement. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach converges substantially faster while consistently improving generation quality, achieving an FID of 1.52 on ImageNet-256.

AI.tldr: 本文提出观察算子扩散模型(OOD)和GL-CoDA解码器，通过时间索引的观察轨迹解决像素空间扩散模型中尺度-时间不匹配问题，实现从粗到细的特征细化，在ImageNet-256上达到1.52的FID分数。
AI.motivation: 当前像素空间扩散模型虽直接建模图像分布，但优化困难。现有的目标重参数化方法仍要求模型在噪声很高时就预测完整图像，产生低信噪比梯度，阻碍模型优化。核心问题是：图像结构从粗到细逐渐可预测，但现有模型被迫在噪声很大时就预测完整图像，造成尺度-时间不匹配。
AI.method: 1. 提出观察算子扩散(OOD)框架，用时间索引的观察轨迹替代标准流程中的固定全图像监督，从粗结构逐渐过渡到完整图像；2. 使用一族高斯-兰索斯算子在不同观察尺度实例化该轨迹，获得路径一致的训练目标；3. 引入GL-CoDA解码器，在解码阶段注入尺度特定的高斯-兰索斯观察，实现从粗到细的特征细化。
AI.result: 收敛速度显著加快，生成质量持续提升。在ImageNet-256上实现FID 1.52。
AI.conclusion: 通过将监督轨迹和特征细化与图像结构的内在恢复顺序对齐，成功解决了尺度-时间不匹配问题，为像素空间扩散模型的优化提供了有效框架。

relevance_reason: The paper is about image generation using diffusion models (ImageNet-256), not 3D motion generation from 2D video. While both use diffusion models, the application domain is completely different - this is image synthesis (computer vision) vs the required 3D motion generation from video (computer graphics/animation). The pain points and methods are unrelated to extracting 3D motion from video or leveraging video generation models for motion synthesis.

title: GuardianBench: A Same-Scene Instruction-Contrastive Benchmark for Latent Contextual Risk in Embodied AI
summary: In embodied AI, safety risk can be latent: a benign instruction and a safe scene become hazardous only when composed. Prior work has advanced embodied safety by varying visual contexts or evaluating execution-time dynamics, but the complementary axis of fixing the scene and varying only the instruction remains underexplored. We introduce GuardianBench, an instruction-contrastive benchmark grounded in international safety standards that isolates this latent contextual risk through 3,024 instruction-scene examples organized as same-scene Safe/Unsafe contrastive pairs across various hazard categories. Benchmarking state-of-the-art vision-language models (VLMs) reveals instruction-insensitive verdicts: models disproportionately approve both instructions under a given scene; across the primary models, average pair accuracy is only 24.1%. Our systematic rationale audit localizes the dominant failure: models fail to bind the instruction-relevant cues that differentiate safe from unsafe compositions. As a post-training case study, Verdict Log-Odds Supervision (VLOS), a lightweight verdict-level objective, substantially improves performance on open-weight backbones. Together, our latent contextual risk task formulation, standards-grounded contrastive benchmark construction, pair-level and rationale-level failure diagnosis, and benchmark-enabled verdict calibration establish GuardianBench as a controlled evaluation suite for exposing and improving safety reasoning over instruction-scene compositions under latent contextual risk.

AI.tldr: GuardianBench是一个针对具身AI的指令对比安全基准，通过3024个指令-场景示例（same-scene Safe/Unsafe对比对）来评估视觉语言模型在潜伏上下文风险下的安全推理能力。
AI.motivation: 在具身AI中，安全风险可能是潜伏的： benign指令和安全场景组合后会变得危险。之前工作关注改变视觉上下文或执行时动态，但固定场景只改变指令这个轴未被探索。国际安全标准为基准提供了理论依据。
AI.method: 构建基于国际安全标准的指令对比基准GuardianBench，包含3024个跨多种 hazard categories 的指令-场景示例，组织为same-scene Safe/Unsafe对比对。进行系统性的rationale审计来定位失败原因，并提出VLOS（Verdict Log-Odds Supervision）轻量级判决级目标作为后训练方案。
AI.result: 基准测试显示模型存在指令不敏感判决问题：模型在给定场景下对两个指令都倾向于批准。主要模型平均配对准确率仅24.1%。主要失败原因是模型未能绑定区分安全与不安全组合的指令相关线索。VLOS能显著提升开放权重骨干网络的性能。
AI.conclusion: GuardianBench作为一个受控评估套件，能够暴露和改进指令-场景组合下潜伏上下文风险的安全推理。贡献包括：潜伏上下文风险任务 formulation、基于标准的对比基准构建、配对级和理由级失败诊断、以及基准驱动的判决校准。

While both mention "Visual Language Models (VLMs)", the paper uses VLMs for safety reasoning in embodied AI, not for quality supervision in 3D motion generation. The application domains are entirely different: AI safety vs. computer graphics/motion generation. This paper would not help address any of the stated pain points about extracting 3D guidance from video or generating quality 3D motions.

title: A Scalable Vector Graphics Latent Space
comment: Accepted at The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision -- ECCV 2026
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics are a fundamental medium for resolution-independent visual content, yet the deep learning community lacks a continuous, dense, and invertible latent space for vector representations, the kind of foundational building block that Variational Autoencoders and their descendants have long provided for raster images. We introduce SLS (SVG Latent Space), a Transformer-based autoencoder that learns compact dense representations of individual SVG paths, the atomic visual elements from which any SVG image can be composed. By modeling SVG commands, coordinate data, and visual properties within a unified BPE-based token vocabulary, SLS learns fixed-size latent representations that jointly capture structure and appearance, and can be decoded back into valid, style-consistent SVG paths with high fidelity. The resulting embedding space is robust, invertible, and structured: embeddings lie on a unit hypersphere, enabling efficient similarity search, composition, and downstream conditioning through simple vector-space operations. Finally, we demonstrate that SLS generalizes across diverse tasks reducing their FLOPs by over 150 times compared to token-based approaches, and establishing a general-purpose latent foundation for vector graphics research.

AI.tldr: SLS是一个基于Transformer的自编码器，旨在为SVG（可缩放矢量图形）创建连续、密集且可逆的潜在空间，类似于变分自编码器为光栅图像提供的功能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习社区缺乏用于矢量表示的连续、密集且可逆的潜在空间，而这种潜在空间是变分自编码器及其衍生版本为光栅图像提供的关键构建块。
AI.method: 通过在统一的基于BPE的标记词汇表中建模SVG命令、坐标数据和视觉属性，SLS学习捕获结构和外观的固定大小潜在表示，并可解码回有效、风格一致的SVG路径。
AI.result: 学习到的嵌入空间位于单位超球面上，实现了高效的相似性搜索、组合和通过简单向量空间操作进行下游调节。与基于标记的方法相比，SLS将FLOPs降低了150多倍。
AI.conclusion: SLS为矢量图形研究建立了一个通用的潜在基础，能够跨不同任务进行泛化。

relevance_reason: This paper is about creating latent spaces for 2D SVG (vector graphics), which is completely unrelated to the research profile's focus on 3D motion generation from 2D video. The application domains are fundamentally different: SVG graphics vs 3D human/character motion generation. While both are in computer graphics broadly, this paper deals with 2D vector representation learning, not 3D motion generation, feature extraction from video, or video generation models. The methods (Transformer autoencoder for SVG tokens) have no overlap with the required methods (video generation models, VLM supervision, 3D motion generation).

title: Multimodal Prompt Learning with Irregular EHRs for Robust Monitoring of Critical Care Patients
summary: Accurate assessment of patients in intensive care units (ICUs) is essential for timely clinical intervention and improved patient outcomes. Multimodal electronic health records (EHRs), including structured physiological time series and longitudinal clinical notes, provide complementary information for critical care prediction. However, in real-world clinical settings, individual modalities may be partially observed or entirely unavailable, resulting in substantial performance degradation for existing multimodal models. To address this challenge, we propose a multimodal prompt-learning framework for robust clinical prediction under diverse missing-modality scenarios. The proposed framework introduces four complementary types of prompts: generative prompts, missing-signal prompts, missing-type prompts, and temporal prompts. Generative prompts construct surrogate latent representations for unavailable modalities, while missing-signal prompts distinguish observed representations from generated ones. Missing-type prompts condition the model on different modality-availability configurations, whereas temporal prompts perform condition-specific aggregation over temporally encoded clinical sequences. Together, these prompts enable the model to capture missingness-aware intramodal dependencies and cross-modal interactions within a unified architecture. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms existing approaches across evaluation metrics on two missingness settings. Ablation and robustness analyses further verify the complementary contributions of the four prompt types and the effectiveness of the proposed framework for clinical prediction from incomplete multimodal EHR data.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多模态提示学习框架，用于在模态缺失情况下进行ICU临床预测。该框架通过四种互补的提示类型（生成式提示、缺失信号提示、缺失类型提示和时间提示）来处理不完整的多模态电子健康记录数据，使模型能够捕获缺失感知模态内依赖性和跨模态交互。
AI.motivation: 现实临床环境中，多模态电子健康记录（包括结构化生理时间序列和纵向临床笔记）虽然能提供危重症预测的互补信息，但单个模态可能部分观察或完全不可用，导致现有多模态模型性能大幅下降。
AI.method: 提出统一架构中的四种提示类型：1) 生成式提示为不可用模态构建代理潜在表示；2) 缺失信号提示区分观察表示与生成表示；3) 缺失类型提示对不同模态可用性配置进行条件调节；4) 时间提示对时间编码临床序列进行条件特定聚合。
AI.result: 广泛实验表明，该方法在两种缺失设置下的评估指标均优于现有方法。消融和鲁棒性分析进一步验证了四种提示类型的互补贡献及框架从不完备多模态EHR数据中进行临床预测的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该多模态提示学习框架能够有效处理模态缺失问题，在ICU患者预测任务中展现出良好的性能，为实际临床应用中处理不完整多模态数据提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Entity-Constrained CBCT Retrieval for Low-Resource Dental Record Completion
comment: Accepted at the ODIN 2026 Workshop, MICCAI 2026
summary: Completing dental records from cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is difficult when annotation is scarce and individual clinical fields are supported by different types of evidence. MMDental Task 3 requires seven-field record completion from only 50 labeled CBCT cases and scores the correctness of structured FDI positions and ICD codes; consequently, a visually plausible retrieved record can still be harmful when it introduces an unsupported entity. We propose Entity-Constrained CBCT-Guided Retrieval (ECCR), a parameter-free framework that separates evidence availability from evidence authority. A corpus-derived prior first supplies the complete record. A frozen 3D encoder retrieves image-conditioned Diagnosis evidence, which is appended only if it does not expand the prior FDI or ICD entity set, so the asserted entity set is invariant by construction. On public validation, ECCR reaches a weighted score of 0.3134, improving on both full-record multimodal retrieval (0.2237) and a static text-only prior (0.2915); the guard blocks 63.3% of retrieved candidates, each of which would otherwise have injected an FDI position or ICD code absent from the prior. On the final test evaluation, ECCR obtains 11.37 of a 97.4-point attainable maximum, securing second place overall. The result indicates that, in an extreme low-resource setting, controlling what multimodal evidence is allowed to modify can be more reliable than transferring an entire retrieved record.

AI.tldr: MMDental Task 3要求从仅50个标注的CBCT病例中完成七字段牙科记录补全，提出ECCR框架通过分离证据可用性与证据权威性来控制多模态证据的修改权限，在极端低资源环境下取得了较好的效果。
AI.motivation: 在标注数据稀缺的情况下，从CBCT完成牙科记录补全困难，且个体临床领域需要不同类型的证据支持。视觉上合理的检索记录可能引入不支持的实体，从而造成危害。
AI.method: 提出ECCR（实体约束的CBCT引导检索）框架，包含：1）语料库衍生的先验提供完整记录；2）冻结的3D编码器检索图像条件诊断证据；3）仅当不扩展先验FDI或ICD实体集时才附加证据，确保实体集不变。
AI.result: 公开验证集上达到加权分数0.3134，优于全记录多模态检索(0.2237)和静态文本先验(0.2915)；防护机制阻止了63.3%的检索候选。最终测试获得11.37分（满分97.4），获得第二名。
AI.conclusion: 在极端低资源设置下，控制多模态证据允许修改的内容比转移整个检索记录更可靠。

There is no match in application domain (medical vs computer graphics/motion generation), methods (CBCT retrieval vs video/motion generation), or purpose. This is an entirely different field.

title: AirAlign: Geometry-Aware Relative Pose Alignment for UAV Last-Meter Navigation
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) navigation in modern low-altitude environments requires more accurate pose alignment in the final approach stage for target information acquisition or manipulation, making "last-meter" navigation increasingly important. However, severe viewpoint and appearance variations make this task challenging. To tackle this problem, we propose AirAlign, a framework for RGB-only image-pair relative pose alignment for UAVs. AirAlign uses a pretrained visual geometry reconstruction model as the backbone to extract geometry-aware features from source-target image pairs. In addition, to better utilize the limited training data, we split the training set into multiple scene-disjoint folds for unseen cross-validation and model selection. During inference, the predictions of the selected models are averaged to form the ensemble output of the overall framework. Experiments on the PairUAV challenge at the ACMMM 2026 Workshop on UAVs in Multimedia demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of our method, while comprehensive ablation studies validate the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: AirAlign是一个仅使用RGB图像的无人机相对位姿对齐框架，利用预训练的视觉几何重建模型作为骨干网络提取几何感知特征，并通过场景分离的交叉验证和模型集成来提高鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现代低空环境中无人机导航在最后阶段需要更精确的位姿对齐，但严重的视角和外观变化使得这一任务具有挑战性，"最后一米"导航变得越来越重要。
AI.method: 1) 使用预训练的视觉几何重建模型作为骨干网络，从源-目标图像对中提取几何感知特征；2) 将训练集分割为多个场景分离的折进行未见过的交叉验证和模型选择；3) 在推理时对选定模型的预测进行平均以形成集成输出。
AI.result: 在ACMMM 2026无人机多媒体工作组的PairUAV挑战赛上验证了方法的有效性和鲁棒性，消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: AirAlign框架能够有效实现无人机仅RGB图像的相对位姿对齐，通过几何感知特征提取和模型集成策略提高了在复杂低空环境中的导航精度。

There is no relevance to the Computer Graphics field or the specific research goals outlined.

title: SSDi8: Accurate and Efficient 8-bit Quantization for State Space Duality
summary: Recent advances in sequence modeling have highlighted Mamba as a state space architecture offering efficient long-range dependency modeling and providing a viable alternative to Transformers. Building upon this, Mamba-2 introduces the Structured State Space Duality (SSD), which integrates recurrent and attention modes to achieve efficiency and scalability. However, this architectural expansion substantially increases memory and latency overhead, underscoring the need for efficient compression strategies tailored to SSD. In this work, we present SSDi8, the first post-training quantization framework specifically designed for SSD to maintain a persistent INT8 path. SSDi8 introduces a reformulation that decouples element-wise multiplications from matrix multiplications, enabling reuse of quantized activations across modules. Moreover, SSDi8 adaptively quantizes channel-varying activations at cost-effective points, further reducing latency. On the accuracy side, SSDi8 explicitly leverages the intrinsic dimensional decomposition of SSD, exploiting distinct outlier distributions across axes, and incorporates an error correction term based on per-channel error statistics. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that SSDi8 achieves accuracy comparable to FP16 while delivering up to 1.4x speedup in W4A8 and W8A8 settings. We further validate its robustness in resource-constrained environments by deploying it on the Orin NX device.

AI.tldr: SSDi8是首个针对Mamba-2的SSD架构设计的训练后量化框架，通过解耦元素级乘法和矩阵乘法、通道自适应量化等创新技术，在保持FP16精度的同时实现高达1.4倍的加速，并成功部署在Orin NX设备上验证了其资源受限环境下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: Mamba-2通过结构化状态空间对偶性(SSD)整合了循环和注意力模式，提高了效率和可扩展性，但同时也带来了显著的内存和延迟开销，需要针对SSD设计高效的压缩策略。
AI.method: 1) 重新 formulation解耦元素级乘法和矩阵乘法，实现跨模块量化激活复用；2) 在成本效益点对通道变化激活进行自适应量化；3) 利用SSD内在维度分解，显式利用不同轴上的异常值分布差异；4) 引入基于每通道误差统计的误差校正项。
AI.result: SSDi8在W4A8和W8A8设置下实现与FP16相当的精度，同时提供高达1.4倍的加速，并在Orin NX设备上验证了其在资源受限环境中的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SSDi8作为首个针对SSD的后训练量化框架，通过创新性的架构解耦和自适应量化技术，成功在精度和效率之间取得平衡，为SSD在边缘设备上的部署提供了可行方案。
