title: HANSARD: A Reference Architecture for Forensic Readiness, Runtime Witnessing, and Graded Attribution in Autonomous Multi-Agent AI Systems
summary: Autonomous multi-agent systems nowadays act in finance, software supply chains, and security operations. Already, the first largely AI-orchestrated intrusion campaigns have been reported. Yet, when such a system causes harm, no method can robustly establish what happened, what caused it, or who is accountable. This is because provenance forensics works at the wrong abstraction, formal causality assumes the causal model, and agent auditing trusts self-recording. The target failure mode is, thus, attribution laundering, i.e., spreading an act across redundant agents until none is a but-for cause. Worse, the record is produced by the suspects, which comprises the assumption adopted throughout this work. Agents may therefore anticipate the investigation and the part of logging infrastructure may itself collude. In this paper, HANSARD is proposed, a reference architecture treating accountability as a life-cycle property. First, a readiness profile sealed before operation bounds what later findings may claim. Second, capturing at five choke points beyond the agents' reach makes omissions detectable, not only tampering. Third, a typed PROV-DM-aligned causal graph accrues as the system runs, and three indicators read it live to gate oversight without adjudicating. Fourth, post-incident replay yields contingent effects under the modified Halpern-Pearl definition, together with a compensation-set size. Finally, a synergy residual measures harm due to the combination rather than to individuals, making laundering visible. Cause, responsibility and accountability are then reported separately, each capped by an evidentiary tier, while a future research agenda is also provided.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HANSARD参考架构,将问责制视为生命周期属性,以解决自主多智能体系统造成危害时的归因困难问题。该架构通过准备阶段密封配置文件、在智能体触及范围之外的五个阻塞点进行捕获、构建类型化的PROV-DM对齐因果图、以及事后重放计算修正的Halpern-Pearl定义下的 contingent effects等机制,实现对责任 Attribution laundering(归因洗白)的检测和问责。
AI.motivation: 当前自主多智能体系统已应用于金融、软件供应链和安全运营领域,甚至出现了首次大规模AI编排的入侵活动。然而当此类系统造成危害时,无法稳健地确定发生了什么、原因是什么以及谁应负责。原因在于:溯源取证工作于错误的抽象层次、形式因果关系假设了因果模型、智能体审计依赖自我记录。目标失败模式是"归因 laundering",即跨冗余智能体传播行为直至没有but-for原因,且记录由嫌疑人自己生成,智能体可能 anticipate 调查,部分日志基础设施可能串通。
AI.method: 提出HANSARD参考架构:1)运行前密封准备配置文件以界定后续发现的可能声明;2)在智能体无法触及的五个阻塞点进行捕获,使遗漏可被检测而不仅仅是篡改;3)构建类型化PROV-DM对齐的因果图随系统运行累积,三个指标实时读取以进行监督而无需裁决;4)事后重放在修正的Halpern-Pearl定义下产生连带效应,并计算补偿集大小;5) synergy residual衡量组合造成的伤害而非个人,使laundering可见。原因、责任和问责分别报告,每项由证据层 cap,并提供未来研究议程。
AI.result: 该架构实现了:1)遗漏检测而不仅是篡改检测;2)无需裁决的实时监督;3)归因 laundering 的可见化;4)原因、责任和问责的分离报告,每项由证据层限制。
AI.conclusion: HANSARD通过将问责制作为生命周期属性来处理自主多智能体系统的责任归属问题,在智能体触及范围之外设置捕获点,构建因果图并使用修正的Halpern-Pearl定义进行事后分析,以及通过synergy residual揭示组合效应,使归因 laundering变得可见,为自主智能体系统的可问责性提供了系统性的技术框架。

title: VISTA: Test-Time Compositional Alignment for Visual Autoregressive Generation
summary: Visual autoregressive (VAR) models have emerged as a fast, high-quality alternative to diffusion for text-to-image generation, but like diffusion models they exhibit persistent compositional failures, producing images that violate the attribute bindings and spatial relations specified in the prompt. While a rich line of test-time alignment methods has developed for diffusion, no comparable approach exists for next-scale VAR generation, whose stateful, discrete, multi-resolution sampling process makes existing techniques inapplicable. We close this gap with \textbf{VISTA} (\textbf{Vi}sual Autoregressive \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{T}est-time \textbf{A}lignment), the first gradient-based test-time alignment framework for next-scale autoregressive image generation. Built on Infinity, VISTA intervenes directly in the generation process, optimizing intermediate representations through the frozen transformer to steer visual predictions toward compositional constraints, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional training. VISTA introduces the mechanisms needed to make such optimization stable across scales, together with an extensible objective space that any differentiable constraint on cross-attention can plug into. Across two benchmarks and two model scales, VISTA improves every targeted compositional category, raising the mean targeted score by nearly 20\% on a 2B backbone and almost 6\% on an 8B backbone, with the largest gains on spatial relations. Image quality is preserved: an independent preference model VISTA never optimizes scores its outputs nearly 20\% higher. Notably, the 2B model with VISTA surpasses a backbone four times its size, indicating that a substantial part of the compositional gap between model scales is recoverable at test time.

AI.tldr: VISTA是首个针对下一代自回归图像生成模型的梯度基测试时对齐框架，能够在不修改模型参数的情况下，通过优化中间表征来改善文本到图像生成中的属性绑定和空间关系等组合失败问题。
AI.motivation: 视觉自回归(VAR)模型虽已成为扩散模型的高质量替代方案，但仍存在持续的组合失败问题，如图像违反提示词中指定的属性绑定和空间关系。扩散模型有丰富的测试时对齐方法，但VAR模型特有的状态性、离散性、多分辨率采样过程使得现有技术无法适用，因此需要开发专门针对VAR的测试时对齐方法。
AI.method: VISTA建立在Infinity模型基础上，直接干预生成过程，通过冻结的transformer优化中间表征来引导视觉预测朝向组合约束方向发展，无需修改模型参数或额外训练。其引入了在多个尺度上使优化稳定所需的机制，并提供了可扩展的目标空间，任何关于交叉注意力的可微分约束都可以插入使用。
AI.result: 在两个基准测试和两个模型规模上，VISTA改善了每个目标组合类别，将2B骨干网的平均目标分数提高近20%，8B骨干网提高近6%，空间关系改善最为显著。图像质量得到保持：VISTA从未优化其输出的独立偏好模型分数提高了近20%。值得注意的是，配备VISTA的2B模型超越了其四倍大小的骨干网，表明模型规模间的组合差距大部分可在测试时恢复。
AI.conclusion: VISTA成功证明了梯度基测试时对齐方法可应用于下一代自回归图像生成，为该领域提供了首个此类框架。实验表明测试时优化能有效弥补模型规模差异，为提升自回归模型的组合能力开辟了新途径。

title: CONTRAMEM: Learning Self-Evolving Procedural Memory from Contrasting Multi-Model Trajectories
summary: Autonomous computer-use agents are increasingly applied to long-horizon tasks requiring coordinated application calls, persistent state tracking, and verifier-sensitive writes, yet they remain prone to procedural failures: misreading application state, tool semantics, or task progress. Procedural memory promises more consistent decisions and less redundant exploration, but constructing high-quality memory without model training remains challenging. We introduce CONTRAMEM, a source-flexible, training-free framework for self-evolving procedural memory that treats same-task outcome variation as supervision: differences in correctness, efficiency, recovery, and failure modes expose outcome-relevant procedural distinctions, distilled into a compact bank of app-level Function Cards and task-level Skill Cards that evolves through localized curation rather than append-only accumulation or whole-bank rewriting. On held-out GAIA2/ARE computer-use tasks, CONTRAMEM more than doubles the success rate across the three source-model targets (26.2% to 55.3%), with consistent per-model gains (GPT-5.5: 27.5 to 61.0; Claude Sonnet 4.6: 28.0 to 52.5; DeepSeek V4 Pro: 23.0 to 52.5). The same bank transfers unchanged to the unseen Qwen3.7 Plus (18.5 to 35.5), indicating transferable procedural knowledge rather than model-specific behavior. The same construction carries over unchanged to AppWorld, beating both no memory and its own single-source self-memory variant for all three mid-tier agents on both public test splits. Under a matched trajectory budget, heterogeneous multi-model trajectories yield stronger memory than self- or same-model multi-rollout memory: the margin comes from contrastive behavioral diversity, not stronger source agents or more sampling.

title: RS$^3$-Prune: Read-Sparse, Store-Sparse Token Pruning for Video Object Segmentation
summary: We introduce RS$^3$-Prune, a training-free token-pruning recipe that instantiates as a small set of inference time hooks atop existing video object segmentation (VOS) networks. Modern VOS models have converged on a common, expensive design: an image encoder produces a dense token grid for every frame, and a memory bank accumulates these tokens across all previously processed frames to condition future predictions. As a video grows longer, the resulting token budget governs both per-frame latency and peak GPU memory. Hence these models break on use cases such as --- long-form video or real-time deployment on memory-bounded accelerators. In this work we argue that the right axis along which to compress memory-bank VOS is the token budget itself. RS$^3$-Prune operates in two precise locations within an arbitrary memory-bank VOS pipeline: at the boundary between the image encoder and the memory-attention readout, where we restrict the queries that participate in the cross-frame attention to only a small, geometrically informed subset; and at the boundary between the memory encoder and the memory bank, where we restrict which tokens are ever permitted to enter the bank to those that lie within the object's spatial extent. Over various established benchmarks, RS$^3$-Prune delivers up to $38.8\%$ FPS speedup and reduces $13.1\%$ peak memory usage, while preserving a competitive $\mathcal{J}$&$\mathcal{F}$ compared to the unmodified VOS networks.

AI.tldr: RS³-Prune是一种无需训练的token剪枝方法，通过在视频对象分割网络的两个关键位置限制token数量来提升效率。该方法在图像编码器与内存注意力之间限制查询token数量，并在内存编码器与内存库之间仅保留对象空间范围内的token，实现高达38.8%的FPS加速和13.1%的内存降低。
AI.motivation: 现代视频对象分割(VOS)模型采用高成本的密集token设计，每个帧产生密集token网格，内存库累积所有历史帧的token，导致长视频处理时延迟高、内存消耗大，无法满足长视频或实时部署需求。
AI.method: RS³-Prune在两个精确位置进行token剪枝：1)图像编码器与内存注意力读取之间，限制参与跨帧注意力的查询为少量几何信息子集；2)内存编码器与内存库之间，仅允许位于对象空间范围内的token进入内存库。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，RS³-Prune实现最高38.8%的FPS加速，降低13.1%的峰值内存使用，同时保持具有竞争力的J&F分数。
AI.conclusion: 通过对token预算这一核心轴进行压缩，RS³-Prune成功实现了VOS模型的高效化，为长视频处理和实时部署提供了可行方案。

title: STAGE: Stateful Translation to Agentic Graph Execution with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control
summary: Policy-governed agents must interpret case evidence while following an authorized procedure. We present \textsc{Stage}, an executable-graph framework that confines model judgment to policy-scoped nodes while placing procedural control in deterministic code. At each node, the model receives task-relevant policy context and returns a typed result, while the coordinator enforces the reviewed execution contract. We evaluate \textsc{Stage} on SOP-Bench Referral Abuse, two $τ^2$-bench domains, and Smart Dispute, a proprietary banking benchmark. Compared with monolithic full-policy execution, \textsc{Stage} generally improves task success and repeated-run reliability across workflows of varying procedural complexity. The largest gains occur on the deeper Telecom and Smart Dispute workflows, where $\mathrm{Pass}^3$ increases by 7.5--55.0 and 57.2--65.7 percentage points, respectively, depending on the model. These results show that combining policy-scoped context with deterministic procedural control can improve the reliability of policy execution.

AI.tldr: Stage是一个可执行图框架，通过将模型判断限制在策略作用域节点内，同时将程序控制置于确定性代码中，来提高政策执行的可重复性。在多个基准测试上，该方法相比整体式全策略执行显著提升了任务成功率和多次运行的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 政策治理的智能体在解释案例证据时必须遵循授权程序，但现有方法在执行复杂策略时缺乏可靠性和可重复性。研究者希望找到一种既能保持模型判断能力又能确保程序控制确定性的方法。
AI.method: 提出Stage框架：1)将模型判断限制在政策作用域节点内；2)将程序控制置于确定性代码中；3)每个节点模型接收任务相关策略上下文并返回类型化结果；4)协调器强制执行审查后的执行契约。
AI.result: 在SOP-Bench Referral Abuse、两个τ²-bench领域和Smart Dispute银行基准上评估。相比整体式全策略执行，Stage在程序复杂度不同的工作流中普遍提高了任务成功率和重复运行可靠性。在较深的Telecom和Smart Dispute工作流上提升最大，Pass³分别提高7.5-55.0和57.2-65.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将政策作用域上下文与确定性程序控制相结合，可以显著提高政策执行的可重复性。这一方法为构建更可靠的政策治理智能体提供了有效途径。

title: SymmAdapt: Symmetrical Flow Matching for Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Medical Image Segmentation
comment: Accepted at SASHIMI 2026, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. To appear in the Springer LNCS proceedings of the MICCAI 2026 Satellite Events
summary: Domain shift across imaging modalities and acquisition sites remains a significant barrier to the clinical deployment of segmentation models. Source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (SFUDA) addresses this by adapting a pretrained model to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to sensitive source data. We introduce a novel SFUDA framework built on Symmetrical Flow Matching, a unified generative model that segments an input image and synthesizes a source-like image from a mask within the same learned flow. By initializing inference from a domain-agnostic Gaussian origin, the model preserves structural consistency across domains and grounds predictions in learned anatomy rather than shifted texture statistics. Our pipeline leverages this symmetry to generate reliable pseudo-labels and corresponding source-like synthetic images from unlabeled target data, creating a generative replay buffer that anchors source knowledge during a generative self-training stage that fine-tunes on a joint set of real target and synthetic source-like images. We evaluate on abdominal multi-organ and cardiac segmentation, covering cross-modality MRI<->CT shifts, and multi-site prostate segmentation. Our approach outperforms SFUDA baselines and is competitive with conventional UDA methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于对称流匹配（Symmetrical Flow Matching）的新型无源无监督域适应（SFUDA）框架，用于医学图像分割，能够在不需要访问源数据的情况下将预训练模型适应到无标注的目标域。
AI.motivation: 跨成像模态和采集中心的域偏移是分割模型临床部署的主要障碍，需要一种不需要敏感源数据的域适应方法。
AI.method: 提出对称流匹配框架，作为统一生成模型同时实现图像分割和掩码到源相似图像的合成；从域无关的高斯原点初始化推理以保持结构一致性；利用对称性生成可靠伪标签和源相似合成图像，创建生成重放缓冲区，在生成自训练阶段对真实目标和合成源相似图像进行微调。
AI.result: 在腹部多器官分割、心脏分割（跨模态MRI<->CT偏移）和多中心前列腺分割任务上验证，优于SFUDA基线方法，并与传统UDA方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效解决了域偏移问题，无需访问源数据即可实现高质量分割，适应性强且保护隐私。

title: Scaling Curriculum Learning For Autonomous Driving
comment: 31 pages, 18 figures. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Batched simulators for autonomous driving have recently enabled training reinforcement learning (RL) agents at scale, encompassing thousands of traffic scenarios and billions of interactions within a matter of days. Although such high-throughput feeds RL algorithms faster than ever, their sample-efficiency has not kept pace: As the standard training scheme, domain randomization uniformly samples scenarios, thereby consuming a vast number of interactions on cases that contribute little to learning. Curriculum learning offers a remedy by adaptively prioritizing scenarios that matter most to policy improvement. We present CL4AD, the first integration of curriculum learning into batched autonomous driving simulators by framing scenario selection as an unsupervised environment design problem. We introduce utility functions that shape curricula based on success rates and the realism of the agent's behavior, in addition to existing regret-estimation functions. Large-scale experiments in GPUDRIVE demonstrate that curriculum learning achieves a 99% success rate a billion steps earlier than domain randomization, reducing wall-clock time by 77%, and outperforms heuristic curricula with static and dynamic attributes, with only one exception at the largest scale. An ablation under limited compute shows that curriculum learning improves sample efficiency by 67%. We also investigate how utility functions behave at scale, and how prioritized scenarios evolve during training. We release an implementation of CLForAD in GPUDRIVE.

AI.tldr: CL4AD是首个将课程学习集成到批量自动驾驶模拟器中的方法，通过将场景选择建模为无监督环境设计问题，显著提升了强化学习在自动驾驶任务中的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 批量模拟器虽然能快速生成大量交互数据，但传统的域随机化方法均匀采样场景，导致大量交互浪费在贡献较小的案例上，样本效率低下。
AI.method: 提出CL4AD框架，将场景选择建模为无监督环境设计问题；引入基于成功率、代理行为真实性和遗憾估计的效用函数来塑造课程；在大规模GPUDRIVE模拟器中进行实验。
AI.result: 课程学习比域随机化提前十亿步达到99%成功率，缩短77% wall-clock时间；在静态和动态属性启发式课程中表现最优（仅最大规模时有一例外）；有限计算下消融实验显示样本效率提升67%。
AI.conclusion: 课程学习能够有效解决批量自动驾驶模拟器中的样本效率问题，通过自适应优先处理对策略改进贡献最大的场景，可大幅减少训练时间和计算资源需求。

title: Vision-Language Models for Occupational Physical Exposure Assessment: Estimating External Hand Forces in Manual Material Handling Tasks from RGB Video
summary: External hand forces are important inputs to biomechanical analyses of occupational physical exposure and injury risk, yet continuous force measurements during manual material handling (MMH) typically requires instrumented objects or specialized sensing. We evaluated a vision-language model (VLM)-based pipeline that combines task-specific textual cues, visual representations, and known box mass to estimate dynamic, triaxial, bilateral external hand forces from RGB video. Thirty-five healthy young adults performed five MMH tasks involving lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling with box masses of 6, 9, and 12 kg. The pipeline used text-guided localization of participant and handled-object regions of interest (ROIs), pretrained vision-transformer feature extraction, and transformer-based temporal regression. Performance was evaluated using leave-one-subject-out validation across seven camera-view conditions (three single-view and four multi-view conditions) and four ROI strategies. Overall, root mean square error was ~4.7-5.6 N for the horizontal and mediolateral force components and ~10.6-11.0 N for the vertical component. Including the handled object as a second ROI generally improved force estimation, with some of the largest benefits under single-camera conditions, whereas pixel-level segmentation provided little additional improvement. Multi-camera capture provided the clearest benefit for peak-force estimation, particularly for the vertical component, whereas differences in overall frame-level error among camera configurations were comparatively modest. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of estimating continuous, bilateral, directional hand-force estimates from RGB video and known load mass without requiring sensors on the worker or handled objects as model inputs, supporting the development of more scalable occupational physical exposure and risk assessments.

AI.tldr: 研究开发了一种基于视觉语言模型(VLM)的管道，从RGB视频中估计动态、三轴、双侧外部手力，无需在工人或处理物体上安装传感器。该方法在35名健康成年人执行5种材料搬运任务（提起、携带、推、拉）中进行了验证，使用3种箱体质量（6、9、12 kg）。均方根误差在水平和中外侧力分量约为4.7-5.6 N，垂直分量约为10.6-11.0 N。
AI.motivation: 外部手力是职业体力暴露和损伤风险生物力学分析的重要输入，但连续力测量通常需要仪器化对象或专门传感。本研究旨在开发一种更可扩展的方法，利用已知载荷质量和RGB视频估计手力，无需在工人或处理物体上安装传感器。
AI.method: 使用VLM管道结合任务特定文本提示、视觉表示和已知箱体质量。35名健康年轻成人执行5种MMH任务（提起、携带、推、拉），箱体质量为6、9和12 kg。管道使用文本引导的参与者和处理物体感兴趣区域(ROI)定位、预训练视觉Transformer特征提取和基于Transformer的时间回归。通过留一受试者交叉验证评估7种相机视角条件（3种单视角和4种多视角）和4种ROI策略下的性能。
AI.result: 水平和中外侧力分量的RMSE约为4.7-5.6 N，垂直分量约为10.6-11.0 N。将处理物体作为第二个ROI通常改善了力估计，单相机条件下获益最大，而像素级分割改善甚微。多相机捕获对峰值力估计提供了最明显的好处，特别是垂直分量，而不同相机配置之间的整体帧级误差差异相对较小。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了从RGB视频和已知载荷质量估计连续、双侧、有方向手力估计的可行性，无需传感器作为模型输入，支持开发更可扩展的职业体力暴露和风险评估工具。

title: ExecRubrics: Executable Tool-Augmented Rubrics for Verifiable and Efficient Long-Form Evaluation
summary: Rubrics aim to make language-model evaluation transparent by decomposing response quality into interpretable criteria. However, natural-language rubrics are often ambiguous, require black-box LLM judges, and typically assume criteria aggregate independently through linear weighted sums, limiting their ability to capture dependencies, alternatives, penalties, and override conditions. We propose ExecRubrics, a framework for representing rubrics as compact executable programs. ExecRubrics encodes evaluation logic as verifiable Python scoring functions, giving natural-language rubric intent an operational semantics: a fixed decision procedure that can be inspected, executed, and edited. On three long-form response benchmarks-HealthBench, HelpSteer, and ArgQuality-we show that ExecRubrics can substitute for expensive black-box judges in ranking preferred over dispreferred responses, matching or improving NL rubric baselines with best preference accuracies of 53%, 78%, and 92%, respectively, while reducing evaluation latency by up to 320 times. We show that incorporating external logic and resources from text processing libraries such as NLTK and spaCy further improves preference accuracy. Our results suggest a novel way of looking at evaluation, by offering a faster, more explainable, and less ambiguous alternative to black-box rubric evaluation, particularly in high-stakes domains such as healthcare and banking where precision and auditability are critical.

AI.tldr: ExecRubrics是一个将语言模型评估标准表示为可执行Python程序的框架，通过将评估逻辑编码为可验证的评分函数，替代昂贵的黑盒LLM评判器，实现更快、更可解释的评估。
AI.motivation: 当前自然语言评分标准存在模糊性、需要黑盒LLM评判器、假设标准通过线性加权独立聚合等问题，无法捕捉依赖关系、替代方案、惩罚条件和覆盖条件。

AI.result: 在HealthBench、HelpSteer和ArgQuality三个长响应基准测试中，最佳偏好准确率分别达到53%、78%和92%，评估延迟降低高达320倍，可替代昂贵的黑盒评判器进行排名。
AI.conclusion: 提供了一种更快、更可解释、更少模糊的评分标准评估替代方案，特别适用于医疗和银行等高风险领域，这些领域精确性和可审计性至关重要。

title: AI-based worker guidance in assembly and disassembly operations using multimodal ego/exo-centric data capture and structured task knowledge
comment: 5 pages. Published in CIRP Annals - Manufacturing Technology
summary: Assembly and disassembly processes rely on expert knowledge that is difficult to document, reuse, and transfer. This paper presents a data-centric approach for extracting structured task knowledge from expert demonstrations using egocentric and exocentric recordings. Temporal and multimodal information from video and narration is jointly encoded to derive structured task representations that enable procedural documentation and context-aware worker guidance. The approach is evaluated on a real-world disassembly case study, demonstrating that video-based representations capture procedural structure and execution context beyond static image-based methods. The results highlight the potential of egocentric video understanding for repair, training, and circular manufacturing applications. Project website: https://indego-assistant.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动方法，从专家演示中提取结构化任务知识，利用自我中心（egocentric）和外部视角（exocentric）视频记录，通过时序多模态信息编码实现程序化文档化和上下文感知的工人指导。
AI.motivation: 装配和拆卸过程依赖难以文档化、复用和传递的专家知识，需要一种有效的方法来捕获和传递隐性的过程知识。
AI.method: 联合编码视频和叙述中的时序多模态信息，导出结构化任务表示，实现程序化文档化和上下文感知的工人指导。
AI.result: 基于视频的表示方法能够捕获静态图像方法无法捕捉的程序结构信息和执行上下文，在真实拆卸案例研究中验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 自我中心视频理解在维修、培训和循环制造领域具有重要应用潜力。

relevance_reason: This paper is about industrial worker guidance in assembly/disassembly operations using multimodal video data - this is an industrial engineering/HCI application, NOT Computer Graphics or 3D motion generation. While it does extract information from video (egocentric/exocentric), it focuses on task knowledge representation for worker guidance, not on generating 3D motions from 2D video. The methods, goals, and application domain are completely different from the research profile which specifically deals with 3D motion generation using video generation models (万相, Seedance) and VLMs. The paper doesn't address any of the stated pain points: it doesn't generate 3D motions, doesn't use video generation models, and doesn't bridge 2D visual features to 3D motion space.

title: CausalCache: Conditional High-Fidelity Restoration for Long-Horizon GUI Agents
summary: Long-horizon GUI agents can retain a complete interaction trace cheaply as textual action records, but expose only a few past events to the policy in high-fidelity pixels. We formulate this as conditional fidelity restoration: each event persists in summary-only form and is linked to an archived screenshot, while an active visual-context budget $B$ limits how many events may be promoted to summary-plus-image form. Recent-$B$ spends every slot on the latest events. CausalCache instead reallocates the same $B$ promotions over the complete trace, evicting a recent image only when a distant event has higher conditional marginal utility. Its history-gated key/value (HGKV) adapter modifies only restored history-image tokens and is exactly bypassed with no history image. Matched-budget replacement groups and per-arm-anchored difference-in-differences supervision make uniform history amplification worth zero; a budget-aware selector then chooses which summarized events to restore. On desktop, the frozen policy shows no reliable preference for a task-relevant archived screenshot over the recent frame it would displace; HGKV learns exactly that selectivity inside a pre-specified drift envelope. On OSWorld-Verified, restoring history to high fidelity is worth about $13$ success points over summary-only memory, while same-budget allocations remain indistinguishable. Zero-shot on a cross-application mobile benchmark, CausalCache significantly improves overall success over the same-budget recent allocation ($+3.7$ points on the full roster), and the gain concentrates where it should: $+8.6$ points on the memory-critical split fixed by benchmark metadata at construction, no detectable effect on matched controls, and a significant split-by-method interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalCache方法，解决长程GUI智能体在视觉上下文预算有限的情况下，如何在完整交互历史中最优分配高保真图像显示资源的问题。核心思想是将图像显示预算从仅用于最近事件，重新分配到整个历史轨迹中。
AI.motivation: 当前长程GUI智能体虽然可以低成本保存完整交互痕迹为文本形式，但策略只能访问少量高保真像素图像。每个事件以摘要形式保存并链接到存档截图，而视觉上下文预算B限制了可提升为"摘要+图像"形式的事件数量。现有方法将所有预算用于最新事件，导致历史信息利用不足。
AI.method: 1.条件保真度恢复：每个事件以摘要形式保存并链接存档截图，预算B限制可升级为摘要+图像的事件数量。2.因果缓存(CausalCache)：将相同B次升级重新分配到完整轨迹，仅当遥远事件具有更高条件边际效用时才驱逐最近图像。3.HGKV适配器：仅修改恢复的历史图像token，在无历史图像时完全绕过。4.差分监督：匹配预算的替换组和每臂锚定的差分监督使统一历史放大为零。5.预算感知选择器：选择哪些摘要事件需要恢复为高保真图像。
AI.result: 在桌面环境中，冻结策略对任务相关的存档截图与可驱逐的最近帧之间无可靠偏好，HGKV在指定漂移范围内学习到这种选择性。在OSWorld-Verified上，将历史恢复为高保真相比仅摘要记忆提升约13个成功点，同预算分配无显著差异。在跨应用移动基准的零样本测试中，CausalCache相比相同预算的最近分配显著提升整体成功率达+3.7分，且收益集中在应该集中的地方：在基准元数据构造时确定的记忆关键分割上提升+8.6分，对匹配对照组无显著影响，分割与方法间存在显著交互作用。
AI.conclusion: CausalCache通过智能分配有限的视觉上下文预算，使GUI智能体能够有效利用完整交互历史的视觉信息。实验证明将预算分配到整个历史轨迹而非仅最近事件，可显著提升智能体在需要记忆的任务上的性能，特别是在长程交互场景中。该方法在零样本跨应用迁移中展现出明显的性能优势。

relevance_reason: This paper is about GUI agents and visual memory budget allocation for long-horizon automation tasks, which is completely unrelated to the research profile. The profile focuses on 3D motion generation from video using video generation models and feature extraction pipelines, while this paper focuses on image restoration/compression for GUI agent memory management. The application domains are entirely different - one deals with 3D computer graphics/motion generation, the other deals with AI agents for GUI automation. No relevant methods or applications overlap.

title: OmniCAD: A Large-Scale Benchmark for 3D Spatial Reasoning in Robotics Assemblies
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) show strong capabilities in robotic perception and spatial reasoning, yet their ability to reason about complex mechanical assemblies remains underexplored. We introduce OmniCAD, a large-scale benchmark for assembly-aware 3D spatial reasoning across diverse industrial systems, including robotic mechanisms, automotive components, aerospace structures, and agricultural machinery. OmniCAD contains 25k mechanical assemblies, with an average of 12 parts per assembly and 21 types of mate relationships. Each assembly includes a human-verified ground-truth 3D model and renderings from 20 viewpoints. The benchmark evaluates three capabilities: (1) component-level 3D spatial reasoning, requiring prediction of part positions and orientations; (2) part-to-part relational reasoning, requiring identification of mating relationships and assembly constraints; and (3) tool-augmented agentic reasoning, where models iteratively select viewpoints, inspect visual evidence, and refine predictions. Experiments show that current VLMs struggle with industrial assembly reasoning, often producing inaccurate poses, invalid mating relationships, part interpenetration, and degraded performance as assembly complexity increases. We will open-source the benchmark, evaluation code, and tool interfaces to support research on accurate, physically valid, and scalable 3D assembly reasoning.

AI.tldr: OmniCAD是一个用于评估工业机械装配3D空间推理能力的大规模基准测试，包含25k个机械装配模型，每个平均12个零件和21种配合关系，从20个视角进行渲染。基准测试评估三个能力：组件级3D空间推理、零件间关系推理和工具增强的智能体推理。实验表明当前VLM在工业装配推理方面表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉语言模型(VLM)在机器人感知和空间推理方面表现出色，但对复杂机械装配的推理能力尚未得到充分探索。需要一个大规模的基准测试来评估和推动这一领域的研究。
AI.method: 构建了包含25k个机械装配的OmniCAD基准，涵盖机器人机构、汽车零部件、航空航天结构和农业机械。每个装配包含人类验证的3D模型和20个视角的渲染图。设计了三项评估任务：组件级3D空间推理预测零件位置和方向；零件间关系推理识别配合关系和装配约束；工具增强的智能体推理让模型迭代选择视角、检查视觉证据并优化预测。
AI.result: 当前VLM在工业装配推理方面存在困难，经常产生不准确的姿态、无效的配合关系、零件 interpenetration（零件穿透），且随着装配复杂度增加性能下降。
AI.conclusion: VLM在复杂工业装配推理方面存在显著挑战，需要开发更强大的方法来支持准确、物理有效且可扩展的3D装配推理。研究团队将开源基准测试、评估代码和工具接口以支持该领域研究。

relevance_reason: This paper is about VLM for 3D spatial reasoning in industrial robotics assemblies (predicting part positions in mechanical assemblies), which is completely different from the research profile about 3D human motion generation from video. Although both mention VLM, the application domain is entirely different - this is mechanical/robotics assembly reasoning, not video-to-3D-motion generation. The pain points, methods (video generation models for motion), and goals (generating 3D motions from video) do not align with this benchmark evaluation paper about industrial assembly reasoning.

title: Weakly supervised concept Bottleneck Learning for Robust Two stage Object centric visual reasoning
summary: Two-stage neuro-symbolic architectures provide an elegant paradigm for visual problem solving by cleanly separating connectionist perception of predefined symbols from possibly later defined relational reasoning thereon. However, anchoring high-level predicates into visual frames typically necessitates annotations that are expensive to acquire. In this work, we introduce the Dynamic Orthogonal Concept Bottleneck (D-OCB), an object-centric slot- VAE framework designed to extract human-aligned symbolic predicates under extremely weak supervision. D-OCB eliminates the arduous manual tuning of loss-balancing coef- ficients by dynamically learning optimal hyperparameter allocations during training. To infuse prior knowledge on independence of concept categories, in addition to standard re- construction self-supervision we penalize correlation across concept subspaces. Crucially, to combat the instability of very low supervision regimes, D-OCB incorporates a dynamic di- mensionality allocation mechanism; this adaptive formulation allows well-represented con- cepts to yield latent dimensions to underperforming concepts that are lagging behind, effectively preventing representation collapse and significantly improving overall concept accuracy. Through an extensive empirical evaluation, we demonstrate that our framework achieves high concept alignment and downstream visual reasoning accuracy using minimal label budgets, matching or outperforming end-to-end paradigms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态正交概念瓶颈(D-OCB)，一种基于对象中心槽-VAE的框架，用于在极弱监督下提取与人类对齐的符号谓词。该框架通过动态学习最优超参数分配和自适应维度分配机制，有效防止表示崩溃，显著提升概念准确性。
AI.motivation: 两阶段神经符号架构虽然能清晰分离感知与推理，但将高级谓词锚定到视觉帧通常需要昂贵的标注成本。现有方法在极低监督场景下存在不稳定性和表示崩溃问题。
AI.method: 1) 采用对象中心槽-VAE框架提取符号概念；2) 动态学习最优超参数分配以消除手动调参负担；3) 惩罚概念子空间间的相关性以融入类别独立性先验；4) 引入动态维度分配机制，让表现好的概念向落后概念让出潜在维度。
AI.result: 在极弱监督下实现了高概念对齐性和下游视觉推理准确率，使用 minimal label budgets 即可匹配或超越端到端方法。
AI.conclusion: D-OCB通过自适应机制有效解决了视觉问题求解中的标注昂贵问题，为极弱监督场景下的概念学习提供了有效范式。

relevance_reason: This paper is about weakly supervised concept bottleneck learning for visual reasoning using slot-VAE, which is in the Computer Vision domain for object-centric perception and symbol extraction. It has NOTHING to do with 3D motion generation, video generation models (万相, Seedance), or bridging 2D visual features to 3D motion space - which are the core topics in the research profile. The application domains are completely different: the profile is about Computer Graphics (3D motion generation), while this paper is about Computer Vision (visual reasoning).

title: Multiple View Neural Regression of a Facial Shape Model
summary:
Creating re-topologized 3D facial meshes is essential for high-quality facial animation but remains labor-intensive and time-consuming. This dissertation explores more efficient approaches for capturing production-ready facial meshes through: (1) the development of VarIS, a custom light sphere for capturing high-resolution stereo geometry and reflectance maps; (2) analysis of camera parameters affecting automatic 2D and 3D landmarking; (3) synthetic-data methods for training neural face regression; and (4) techniques for improving neural multi-view face-shape regression.
  While VarIS enables photorealistic face capture, its operational and processing costs motivate a more scalable approach. A deep learning framework is therefore proposed to directly predict re-topologized facial meshes from synthetic multiview images generated with Visage Craft, an in-house physically based rendering system using an Appearance 3D Morphable Model (A3DMM). The system produces standardized meshes ready for rigging and animation with minimal human supervision. Results show that incorporating accurate camera intrinsics and extrinsics improves landmark accuracy and geometric consistency, while 3D landmark regularization further improves reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究如何高效捕获用于高质量面部动画的重拓扑3D面部网格。提出了VarIS自定义光球用于捕获高分辨率立体几何和反射图，开发了基于Visage Craft渲染系统的深度学习框架，直接从合成多视图图像预测重拓扑面部网格。
AI.motivation: 创建重拓扑3D面部网格对于高质量面部动画至关重要，但目前仍面临劳动密集且耗时的挑战。需要探索更高效的捕获生产级面部网格的方法。
AI.method: 1) 开发VarIS自定义光球捕获高分辨率立体几何和反射图；2) 分析相机参数对自动2D和3D标定点的影响；3) 使用合成数据方法训练神经面部回归；4) 提出深度学习框架从合成多视图图像预测重拓扑面部网格；5) Visage Craft使用外观3D可变形模型(A3DMM)生成标准化网格。
AI.result: incorporating accurate camera intrinsics and extrinsics improves landmark accuracy and geometric consistency, while 3D landmark regularization further improves reconstruction quality
AI.conclusion: 该系统可产生可直接用于绑定和动画的标准化网格，只需最少人工监督。准确相机内外参数可提高标定点精度和几何一致性，3D标定点正则化进一步提升重建质量。

relevance_reason: This paper addresses 3D facial mesh capture for animation, which is fundamentally different from the research profile's focus on video-to-3D-motion generation. While both are in Computer Graphics, this paper uses traditional multi-view capture techniques (light stage, A3DMM) rather than modern video generation models or motion generation approaches. The pain points and methods don't align - the profile needs video-to-motion generation with VLMs and diffusion models, while this paper focuses on high-quality facial geometry reconstruction from controlled multi-view setups.

title: Coalition-Aware Skill Reliability for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Agent skills, structured artifacts distilled from interaction trajectories and dynamically reused from skill banks, have become a central mechanism for enabling large language model (LLM)-based self-evolving agents to learn from past experience. Yet existing work has largely focused on the operational aspects of skills, such as acquisition, evolution, and retrieval, while leaving a more fundamental reliability question unresolved: Do accumulated skills in an agent's skill bank actually make positive mechanistic contributions? We investigate this question through systematic skill-bank audits across alternative bank compositions and deployment domains, measuring the resulting changes in agent behavior. These audits reveal two recurring reliability failures: coalition pollution, where bank-level gains conceal negative coalition-level skill contributions, and cross-domain utility reversal, where source-beneficial skills reverse their effects after transfer. These findings motivate two reliability interventions: coalition-aware skill selection during skill accumulation and label-free skill masking after transfer. Coalition-Aware Skill Selection (CASS) selects more reliable candidate skills for the current bank using sampled Shapley marginals. Unsupervised Skill-Masked Coalition Optimizer (u-SMCO) masks transferred skills whose exclusion improves retrieval quality on unlabeled target-domain data. Agentic experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval, HotpotQA, and ALFWorld show that CASS and u-SMCO consistently improve task performance and cross-domain generalization over strong skill-based self-evolving agent baselines. Beyond accuracy, coalition-conditioned reliability modeling reduces sensitivity to noisy outcome-reward fluctuations during reinforcement learning and exposes the limits of isolation-based skill evaluation.

AI.tldr: 研究Agent技能库（Skill Bank）的可靠性问题，提出两种可靠性失效现象（联盟污染和跨域效用逆转）及两种干预方法（CASS和u-SMCO），在多个数据集上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作关注技能的获取、演进和检索等操作层面，但未解决一个根本问题：累积的技能是否真的对Agent行为产生积极的机械性贡献？即技能库的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 1) 系统性技能库审计：在不同银行组成和部署域下测量Agent行为变化；2) 提出两种可靠性干预：联盟感知技能选择(CASS)使用采样Shapley边际值选择更可靠的候选技能；无监督技能掩码联盟优化器(u-SMCO)掩码转移后降低检索质量的技能。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo、LongMemEval、HotpotQA和ALFWorld上的Agent实验表明，CASS和u-SMCO始终优于强基线方法，提升任务性能和跨域泛化能力。联盟条件可靠性建模降低了强化学习对噪声奖励波动的敏感性，并揭示了孤立技能评估的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 技能库的可靠性至关重要，需要采用联盟感知的评估和优化方法；CASS和u-SMCO为解决技能库可靠性问题提供了有效方案。

relevance_reason: This paper is about Agent systems, skill reliability, and coalition learning in Multi-Agent RL - completely unrelated to Computer Graphics and 3D motion generation. The application domain is entirely different: it focuses on agent skill banks, coalition pollution, and task performance in LoCoMo/ALFWorld datasets, while the research profile needs video-to-3D motion generation, visual feature extraction, and video generation models (万相, Seedance). The methods (Shapley values, skill masking) have no overlap with the required methods (VLM supervision, 3D motion generation, feature extraction pipelines).

title: Hyperbolic Hierarchical Clustering for Visual Representation Learning
summary: We investigate the token mixer in vision backbones by revisiting clustering, one of the most classic approaches in machine learning. An effective token mixer is a fundamental component of modern vision backbones like vision Transformers, facilitating information exchange between image patches. Mainstream token mixers, which rely on convolution, attention, MLP, or their hybrids, primarily focus on navigating the trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. However, a significant drawback of these methods is their black-box nature; their encoding process is opaque and lacks interpretability. Diverging from these opaque designs, we introduce ClusterMixer, a transparent token mixer that is grounded in a clustering paradigm and interpretable by design. ClusterMixer explicitly formulates the token mixing process through a hierarchical clustering mechanism. To model the natural, tree-like relationships inherent in visual data, the clustering is performed in hyperbolic space, which is well-suited for embedding hierarchies with low distortion. Building on this innovation, we present HCFormer, a new backbone architecture that integrates ClusterMixer with a series of meticulously designed clustering strategies to ensure robust performance across tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HCFormer consistently outperforms its counterparts across diverse tasks, including image classification, object detection, instance segmentation, and semantic segmentation. Considering its transparency and efficacy, we hope HCFormer can facilitate a paradigm shift toward interpretable backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClusterMixer，一种基于层次聚类的透明token混合器，在双曲空间中进行聚类以建模视觉数据的层次结构，并构建了HCFormer骨干网络。实验表明该方法在图像分类、目标检测、实例分割和语义分割等任务上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有token混合器（卷积、注意力、MLP等）虽然能在精度和计算成本间取得平衡，但存在黑盒问题，编码过程不透明且缺乏可解释性。需要一种透明且可解释的token混合器。
AI.method: 提出ClusterMixer，通过层次聚类机制显式构建token混合过程。为建模视觉数据的自然树状层次关系，在双曲空间中进行聚类（双曲空间适合嵌入层次结构且失真小）。基于此提出HCFormer骨干架构，整合ClusterMixer与精心设计的聚类策略。
AI.result: HCFormer在多个任务上持续优于对比方法，包括图像分类、目标检测、实例分割和语义分割。
AI.conclusion: HCFormer展示了透明可解释骨干网络的潜力，有望推动可解释骨干网络范式的转变。

relevance_reason: This paper is about visual representation learning (image classification, detection, segmentation) using hyperbolic hierarchical clustering in computer vision. The research profile is specifically about 3D MOTION generation from 2D video using video generation models and VLMs. These are completely different application domains - the profile targets motion synthesis while this paper targets image understanding/recognition. The methods (hierarchical clustering in hyperbolic space vs video generation + motion models) are also entirely different. This paper would not help with extracting 3D visual guidance features, generating 3D motions, or bridging 2D-to-3D motion spaces.

title: DeepSAGE: Stage-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Structured CBT Counseling Dialogue
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based counseling agents can generate fluent and supportive responses, but they often lack the structured, goal-directed progression required to conduct a coherent therapeutic session. We present DeepSAGE (Strategic AI Guidance Engine), a hybrid LLM--Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) framework for stage-aware counseling dialogue grounded in the first session of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). DeepSAGE represents the session as eleven stages with explicit therapeutic objectives, with an external controller determines stage completion and the DRL model selects therapeutic intentions that guide LLM response generation. We evaluate DeepSAGE against six retrieval-, prompting-, stage-, and policy-based alternatives. DeepSAGE elicits higher simulated client engagement and openness and achieves the strongest balance of stage-goal completion and dialogue efficiency among stage-structured systems. Domain expert review further indicates that the generated conversations exhibit broadly plausible emotional trajectories and recognizable CBT processes. Because the evaluation relies primarily on simulated clients and model-based metrics, these findings demonstrate comparative dialogue-control improvements rather than clinical effectiveness. These results suggest that combining stage-structured dialogue with learned strategy selection is a promising approach for AI counseling, though clinical effectiveness, safety, and real-world utility require further human evaluation.

AI.tldr: DeepSAGE是一个结合大语言模型与深度强化学习的混合框架，用于实现基于认知行为疗法(CBT)第一阶段的阶段感知心理咨询对话系统。该系统将会话表示为11个阶段，外部控制器确定阶段完成状态，DRL模型选择治疗意图来指导LLM响应生成。实验表明该系统在模拟客户参与度、开放性及阶段目标完成率方面优于6种基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM咨询代理虽然能生成流畅且具有支持性的回复，但缺乏进行连贯治疗会话所需的结构化、目标导向的进展机制。
AI.method: 提出DeepSAGE框架，包含：(1)将会话表示为11个具有明确治疗目标的阶段；(2)外部控制器判断阶段是否完成；(3)深度强化学习模型选择治疗意图以引导LLM生成响应。

title: Contextrast++: Robust Multi-Scale Contextual Contrastive Learning for Semantic Segmentation
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI), 2026
summary: Semantic segmentation has rapidly advanced with deep learning; however, challenges remain in effectively capturing local and global contexts as well as addressing the long-tailed distribution problem. To tackle these issues, we present Contextrast++, a robust contrastive learning method for semantic segmentation that improves multi-scale feature integration and mitigates class imbalance issues. Our method consists of two key components: 1) contextual contrastive learning (CCL) and 2) boundary-aware negative (BANE) sampling. CCL includes three subcomponents: adaptive fusion module, pixel-to-anchor (PA) loss, and anchor-to-anchor (AA) loss. The adaptive fusion module dynamically balances local and global feature integration, resulting in a more context-aware representation. While the PA loss leverages the fused multi-scale features to improve feature representation learning, the AA loss focuses on addressing the long-tailed distribution problem by utilizing a memory bank that stores a fixed number of class-balanced representative anchors. Meanwhile, BANE sampling enhances segmentation precision by selecting hard negatives from misclassified boundary regions, which refines fine-grained details during contrastive learning. As verified in extensive experiments using public datasets, we demonstrate that Contextrast++ substantially improves semantic segmentation performance over existing contrastive learning-based state-of-the-art approaches, while introducing no additional computational overhead during inference.

AI.tldr: Contextrast++是一种基于对比学习的语义分割方法，通过上下文对比学习(CCL)和边界感知负采样(BANE)两个组件来解决局部/全局上下文捕获和类别不平衡问题。CCL包含自适应融合模块、像素-锚点损失和锚点-锚点损失三个子组件，分别用于平衡多尺度特征融合、改进特征表示学习和解决长尾分布问题。BANE则通过从错误分类的边界区域选择困难负样本来提升分割精度。实验表明该方法在公开数据集上显著优于现有对比学习SOTA方法，且推理时无额外计算开销。
AI.motivation: 语义分割领域虽然随着深度学习快速发展，但仍面临两大挑战：1) 有效捕获局部和全局上下文信息；2) 解决长尾分布问题（类别不平衡）。现有方法难以同时兼顾多尺度特征融合和类别平衡，导致分割精度受限，尤其是对少数类的分割效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出Contextrast++方法，包含两个核心组件：1) 上下文对比学习(CCL)：包含自适应融合模块（动态平衡局部和全局特征）、像素-锚点(PA)损失（利用融合的多尺度特征改进表示学习）、锚点-锚点(AA)损失（使用记忆库存储类平衡的代表性锚点解决长尾问题）；2) 边界感知负采样(BANE)：从错误分类的边界区域选择困难负样本，细化细粒度细节。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上进行广泛实验验证，Contextrast++显著提升了语义分割性能，超越了现有基于对比学习的SOTA方法，且在推理阶段不引入额外计算开销。
AI.conclusion: Contextrast++通过创新的对比学习框架有效解决了语义分割中的上下文捕获和类别不平衡问题，为长尾分布场景下的语义分割提供了新的解决思路，具有重要的实用价值。

title: CAI-DLLM: Convergence Aware Inference for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models can generate many tokens in parallel, but they still require repeated denoising steps during inference. This makes generation costly, especially when the model continues to recompute tokens that are already stable. To address these limitations, we propose CAI-DLLM, a training-free inference method that uses first-step confidence to guide denoising and reduce inference time. Specifically, CAI-DLLM commits easy tokens earlier, allocates more denoising steps to harder tokens, and adjusts decoding schedules across output blocks. As it relies only on first-step confidence signals, it does not require retraining, extra predictors, or weight updates. We evaluate CAI-DLLM on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-7B-Instruct across math, code, reasoning, commonsense, and long-context tasks. CAI-DLLM achieves up to 18.2x wall clock inference speedup on LLaDA GSM8K while improving accuracy from 76.27% to 77.41%, and up to 13.1x speedup on Dream HumanEval while achieving higher pass@1 than no-cache inference, 48.17% compared with 46.95%. On harder reasoning tasks, speedups reach 44.8x, with a largest accuracy drop of 4.4 points, while energy consumption is reduced by up to 95.3%.

AI.tldr: CAI-DLLM是一种免训练的推理加速方法，通过首步置信度指导去噪过程，减少扩散语言模型的推理时间。该方法提前提交简单token，为困难token分配更多去噪步骤，并调整输出块的解码 schedules。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽然可以并行生成多个token，但推理时仍需重复去噪步骤，导致计算成本高。特别是模型会重复计算已经稳定的token，造成资源浪费。
AI.method: CAI-DLLM利用首步置信度信号来指导去噪过程，具体包括：1)提前提交简单token；2)为困难token分配更多去噪步骤；3)调整输出块的解码时间表。该方法不需要重训练、额外预测器或权重更新。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-7B-Instruct上评估，在数学、代码、推理、常识和长上下文任务中：LLaDA GSM8K最高加速18.2倍，准确率从76.27%提升到77.41%；Dream HumanEval加速13.1倍，pass@1从46.95%提升到48.17%；困难推理任务加速达44.8倍，准确率最多下降4.4点，能耗降低最多95.3%。
AI.conclusion: CAI-DLLM是一种有效的扩散语言模型推理加速方法，能够在保持甚至提升准确率的同时显著减少推理时间和能耗。该方法的优点是无需额外训练或修改模型权重，具有良好的实用价值。

title: MorphoCLIP: Text-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Perturbation Matching in Cell Painting Images
summary: Cell Painting microscopy captures how cells change after a chemical or genetic perturbation. Connecting these images to the perturbations that produced them could make large imaging screens easier to search and interpret, but the task remains difficult because biological effects are subtle and technical variation is substantial. We introduce MorphoCLIP, a contrastive model that links Cell Painting profiles with text descriptions of compounds, CRISPR knockouts, and ORF overexpressions. The model keeps its vision and language backbones frozen and trains only a compact cross-channel module and projection layers, so it can be trained on a single consumer GPU. On held-out CPJUMP1 data, MorphoCLIP searches in both directions: from a cell image to its perturbation description and from a description to matching cell images. In both cases, a correct match appears among the top ten results much more often than expected by chance. Adding a replicate-alignment loss makes profiles from repeated experiments more consistent, although this improvement does not yet translate into reliable gene-compound matching. Gene-aware labels and plate correction also show no consistent retrieval benefit. These findings suggest that text supervision can help organize chemical and genetic Cell Painting data. Matching compounds with genetic perturbations, however, remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: MorphoCLIP是一个对比学习模型，将Cell Painting显微镜图像与化学物质、CRISPR敲除和ORF过表达的文本描述关联起来。该模型冻结视觉和语言骨干网络，仅训练紧凑的跨通道模块和投影层，可在单个消费级GPU上训练。在CPJUMP1数据上，双向检索（图像到文本、文本到图像）的top-10准确率均显著高于随机水平。
AI.motivation: Cell Painting显微镜技术可捕获细胞在化学或基因扰动后的变化，但将图像与产生这些变化的扰动关联起来仍很困难，因为生物效应微妙且技术变异较大。需要一种方法来组织大型成像筛选数据，使其易于搜索和解释。
AI.method: 使用对比学习框架，构建连接Cell Painting图像与文本描述的MorphoCLIP模型。冻结视觉和语言骨干网络，仅训练跨通道模块和投影层以降低成本。引入复制对齐损失使重复实验的图像特征更一致。
AI.result: 双向检索任务中，正确匹配出现在top-10结果中的频率远超随机预期。复制对齐损失确实提高了重复实验的图像一致性，但并未转化为可靠的成功匹配。基因感知标签和板校正未显示出一致的检索益处。
AI.conclusion: 文本监督可帮助组织化学和基因扰动的Cell Painting数据。然而，化学物质与基因扰动的匹配仍是一个未解决的问题。

title: A-CPES: A Reference Framework for Agentic AI in Cyber-Physical Energy Systems
summary: Energy system operation contains a loop of work that automation has never taken over: posing the optimization problem the current cycle should solve, disposing of infeasibility, sequencing a solution into interlocked switching orders, assembling evidence no single model holds, negotiating adjustable capacity with many parties, and settling experience into practice. Licensed dispatchers carry all of it in person, and the rising share of variable renewable generation is making that loop turn faster than their number can grow. Agentic AI supplies the abilities it requires, but enters as the outer loop of control: it calls SCED and the other decision models rather than being called by them. We propose A-CPES, three nested rings, an authorization and accountability frame around an agentic control outer loop around a six-layer CPES core. We argue the loop is indivisible, tune where and how tightly it may close, state eight structural failure modes as falsifiable predictions, and specify six governance modules that rebuild the authorization frame until it covers the loop, before the loop starts turning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-CPES框架，通过三层嵌套环结构（授权问责环、代理控制外环、六层CPES核心）解决能源系统运营中人工调度瓶颈问题，并提出八种结构故障模式作为可证伪预测，以及六种治理模块来重建授权框架。

title: Hybrid Generative-Discriminative Object Placement
summary: As an important operation of image composition, object placement aims to predict the plausible placement (location, scale) for the inserted foreground object. Previous object placement methods can be divided into generative methods and discriminative methods, both of which cannot balance efficiency and effectiveness well. In this work, we propose a semi-generative method in the middle ground between them. In particular, we assign uniformly distributed anchors on the background. Then, we fuse foreground and background features to predict the rationality score for each anchor and predict plausible placement sets for positive anchors. Extensive experiments on the OPA dataset show that our method can strike a good balance between efficiency and effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种介于生成式和判别式方法之间的半生成式目标放置方法，通过在背景上均匀分布锚点，融合前景和背景特征来预测每个锚点的合理性分数和可placement集，在OPA数据集上实现了效率与效果的良好平衡。

title: Robustness Analysis of Agentic AI to Inconsistent and Incomplete Tool Responses
summary: Robustness to a bad tool return means answering it in the way that return calls for, which depends on how the tool went wrong. A tool that has failed and a tool that returns a well-formed falsehood are different problems with different remedies. We ask whether the two already differ at the moment the return arrives. This is a qualitative pilot study: we score single decision points rather than running agents to completion. We inject controlled faults into a retail customer-service domain and read two channels off the model's log-probabilities: the likelihood of the returned content under the tool schema alone and under the whole trajectory, and its distribution over the legal actions, read for both shape and where the mass sits. An incomplete return is legible in every case, being improbable under the schema alone in a range no other condition enters, and it moves the mass toward the tools that re-read state wherever there is room to move. An inconsistent return leaves the schema channel untouched and registers in the likelihood comparison on the field whose true value the context already carries verbatim, not on the one whose contradiction runs through the domain policy. The action distribution gives each condition a distinct signature, but orders them by how far the return bears on the next action rather than by fault family. Recognition is therefore asymmetric: each condition is legible in some channel, and no channel is legible on all of them.

AI.tldr: 研究AI代理是否能区分工具返回的不同故障类型（失败工具 vs 返回虚假信息），通过分析模型的对数概率在不同通道中的表现来识别故障。

title: Does Rank Still Matter? Position Bias When AI Agents Shop on Our Behalf
summary: Search rankings are valuable because human attention is scarce and sequential. Higher-placed alternatives are easier to find, so they are examined and bought more often. Consumers are now delegating search to AI agents that can ingest an entire results page at once. Randomizing the order of one hundred hotel listings across 5,000 AI agent sessions, we compare four large language models against human field data. AI agents search more deeply than humans and never decline to buy. Position still predicts which listings are inspected, but weakly and non-monotonically: the middle of a results page has the lowest probability of inspection, not the bottom. Position reaches the choice stage for some models and not others, a heterogeneity that tracks neither provider nor capability. All models nonetheless converge on the same undominated listing. For agentic search, the attributes displayed on a results page matter more than placement within it.

title: Seeing the Unseen: Semantic-in-Gaussian for Sparse-View 3D Generalization

summary: Generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (G-3DGS) has emerged as a promising approach for novel view synthesis undersparse-view settings. However, existing frameworks remain restricted by pixel-aligned Gaussian estimation, whichstruggles in partially observed or occluded regions and often leads to incomplete surfaces or structural collapse. Toaddress these challenges, we propose SeeU (Seeing the Unseen), a novel G-3DGS framework. We frame its core design asSemantic-in-Gaussian: semantic-conditioned refinement in Gaussian space. Specifically, we introduce a Cross-viewEntropy-Aware (CEA) module that aggregates multi-view semantic and geometric cues into compact embeddings. Theseembeddings guide the Conditional Gaussian Transformer, which applies residual updates to coarse Gaussians, helpingrecover under-constrained regions of partially observed structures while preserving surface consistency. Comprehensiveexperiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SeeU consistently improves rendering quality and structuralcompleteness while retaining efficient feed-forward inference. Especially under challenging extrapolation settings,SeeU achieves an average improvement of 2.44 dB in PSNR compared to recent SOTA G-3DGS methods.

AI.tldr: SeeU是一种新型通用3D高斯喷溅(G-3DGS)框架,用于稀疏视角下的新视角合成,通过语义条件高斯 refinement解决部分观测或遮挡区域的结构坍塌问题。
AI.motivation: 现有G-3DGS框架受限于像素对齐的高斯估计,难以处理部分观测或遮挡区域,经常导致表面不完整或结构坍塌。
AI.method: 提出Semantic-in-Gaussian设计:1)跨视图熵感知(CEA)模块聚合多视图语义和几何线索到紧凑embedding;2)条件高斯Transformer应用残差更新粗粒度高斯,恢复欠约束区域同时保持表面一致性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上,SeeU持续提升渲染质量和结构完整性,保持高效的前馈推理。在挑战性的外推设置下,PSNR平均提升2.44 dB。
AI.conclusion: SeeU通过语义条件高斯refinement有效解决了稀疏视角下部分观测结构的重建问题,在渲染质量和结构完整性方面均优于现有SOTA方法。

relevance_reason: The paper is about 3D Gaussian Splatting for novel view synthesis (rendering), which is completely different from 3D motion generation from video. While both are in Computer Graphics, the application domains are entirely different: the research profile seeks methods for extracting 3D motion from 2D video (human motion generation), whereas this paper addresses view synthesis and rendering quality. The methods (3DGS rendering vs video-to-motion generation models like diffusion) and goals (novel view rendering vs motion generation) are unrelated.

title: CacheRouter: A Dual-Path Tool Routing Architecture with Cache-Preserving Main-Model Isolation for Long-Tail Tool Discovery
summary: Tool use in LLM systems faces a structural trade-off. Progressive disclosure keeps the prompt small by showing only the tools relevant to the current task, while prompt caching rewards a request prefix that stays fixed across calls; every change to the visible tool list invalidates the cached prefix. This paper treats the trade-off as a problem of request architecture and proposes a dual-path routing design that assigns tool selection and tool delivery to separate channels. The main model always sees a small, fixed set of core tools, so the head of its request is unchanged across calls; all other tools are reached through an independent routing channel, in which a router sub-model searches the full tool list, selects one tool, executes it, and returns the result. Tool registration is automated from source code and supports runtime updates, so the tool set can grow without modifying the main model's request prefix. The design generalizes progressive disclosure: capabilities are disclosed through the routing channel, and the main model's prefix stays stable. A prototype implementation was exercised on 55 functional queries and a 30-turn dialogue; token-level cache hit rates reached 90.99% and 95.2%, cutting input cost to about 12.0% and 8.0% of a no-cache baseline under DeepSeek's pricing, where cache-hit input tokens cost roughly 1/30 of cache-miss tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM系统中工具使用面临的结构性权衡问题——渐进式披露与提示缓存之间的冲突——提出了一种双路径路由设计，将工具选择和工具传递分离到不同通道中，以实现高效缓存与灵活工具扩展的兼得。
AI.motivation: LLM系统的工具使用中存在一个结构性权衡：一方面，渐进式披露通过仅展示当前任务相关的工具来保持提示的简洁；另一方面，提示缓存机制要求请求前缀在不同调用之间保持不变，而工具列表的任何变化都会使缓存的前缀失效。这两者之间存在不可调和的矛盾。
AI.method: 提出一种双路径路由架构设计，将工具选择和工具传递分离到两个独立通道。主模型始终看到一小部分固定的核心工具，因此其请求头在不同调用之间保持不变；其他所有工具通过独立的路由通道访问，在该通道中，路由器子模型搜索完整工具列表、选择并执行工具、返回结果。工具注册从源代码自动化实现并支持运行时更新，使工具集可以扩展而无需修改主模型的请求前缀。
AI.result: 在55个功能查询和30轮对话的测试中，token级缓存命中率分别达到90.99%和95.2%。在DeepSeek定价下，输入成本分别降至无缓存基线的约12.0%和8.0%（缓存命中的输入token成本约为缓存未命中token的1/30）。
AI.conclusion: 该设计将渐进式披露泛化为通过路由通道披露能力，而主模型前缀保持稳定，有效解决了工具使用中渐进式披露与提示缓存之间的权衡问题，实现了高效缓存与工具灵活扩展的兼得。

relevance_reason: This paper is about LLM tool routing and cache optimization, which is completely unrelated to Computer Graphics and 3D motion generation. The application domain is LLM systems infrastructure, not computer graphics, video generation, or 3D motion generation. It addresses a completely different problem (token caching vs 3D visual guidance features) and uses different methods (routing architecture vs video generation models). This is a different field entirely.

title: Object-Uni: A Unified Model for Object-Centric Spatial Understanding and Controllable Generation
summary: Unified models for visual understanding and generation have made rapid progress, yet they still lack the ability to understand and manipulate the spatial states of object instances. Existing models can describe objects in natural language, but they struggle to precisely represent continuous object poses and generate geometrically consistent images under target viewpoints. To mitigate this, we propose \emph{Object-Uni}, a unified model for object-centric spatial understanding and controllable generation. Specifically, we formulate object-centric spatial intelligence as a unified problem connecting pose perception, spatial reasoning, pose-conditioned generation, and object-centric novel view synthesis. We treat object pose as an explicit geometric variable shared by understanding and generation, rather than merely a prediction label or control signal. To make pose usable by multimodal large language models, we propose a viewpoint-based orientation abstraction that maps orientation into structured viewpoint descriptions while preserving continuous geometric supervision. We further construct an object-centric spatial benchmark (UniSpatial-80K) and train a unified model with an object-token-grounded pose anchor to associate each instance with its pose state. Experiments show that our model improves object-level pose understanding and pose-controllable generation, moving unified models from describing objects toward manipulating spatial states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Object-Uni，一个统一的对象中心空间理解和可控生成模型，将对象姿态作为显式几何变量，连接姿态感知、空间推理、姿态条件生成和新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有统一模型缺乏理解和管理对象实例空间状态的能力，无法精确表示连续对象姿态并在目标视角下生成几何一致性的图像。
AI.method: 1)将对象中心空间智能表述为连接姿态感知、空间推理、姿态条件生成和新视角统一的联合问题；2)将对象姿态作为显式几何变量而非预测标签；3)提出基于视角的方向抽象，将方向映射为结构化视角描述；4)构建UniSpatial-80K对象中心空间基准；5)使用对象token锚定的姿态锚来关联实例与姿态状态。
AI.result: 模型在对象级姿态理解和姿态可控生成方面取得提升，使统一模型从描述对象走向操作空间状态。
AI.conclusion: 通过将姿态作为显式几何变量并构建统一框架，Object-Uni成功实现了对象中心空间智能的理解与生成统一，推动了多模态大语言模型在空间状态操作方面的发展。

relevance_reason: Completely different application domain. The research profile focuses on 3D MOTION generation from 2D video (human/character motion), while this paper (Object-Uni) focuses on object-centric SPATIAL understanding and controllable IMAGE generation (static images with pose control). Motion generation vs. image generation are fundamentally different applications in computer graphics. The paper addresses object pose understanding and view synthesis for image generation, not 3D motion generation or video-to-motion translation.

title: SEAM: Shot Entity-Attribute Memory for Consistent Short-Drama Generation at Scale
summary: Short-drama generation has grown into a large, industrialized pipeline, and as it scales from isolated shots to the episode level, visual continuity has become a critical bottleneck. Current agent frameworks generate each shot in isolation, so context drifts across shots and props, character posture, and blocking turn inconsistent. Once assembled, these small discrepancies amplify into severe visual breaks. We present SEAM (Shot Entity-Attribute Memory), a training-free, model-agnostic memory graph that repairs continuity entirely at the prompt-text layer by extracting a multi-dimensional state for every shot, retrieving only causally prior context over the resulting graph, filtering it selectively, and injecting the surviving constraints by natural-language prompt rewriting. We further release SEAM-Bench, a double-blind continuity storyboarding benchmark, on which SEAM raises cross-episode continuity recall from 0.700 to 0.946, generalizes across six mainstream text models, and yields consistent, though not yet significant, gains at the generated-image layer. Deployed as a mandatory stage in CreativeFitting's SEAM-Agent production pipeline over 201 shots, SEAM reaches a 96.5% director-acceptance rate with zero unsafe injections; a conservative counterfactual attributes at least 21.9 percentage points of that rate to its cross-episode memory.

AI.tldr: SEAM是一个无需训练、模型无关的记忆图谱，通过在提示词层面提取每帧多维状态、检索因果先验上下文、选择性过滤并通过自然语言提示重写来修复短视频生成的视觉连续性问题。
AI.motivation: 随着短剧生成从孤立镜头扩展到剧集级别，视觉连续性成为关键瓶颈。当前智能体框架孤立生成每帧镜头，导致上下文漂移，角色姿态、服装、道具等不一致，最终组装后产生严重视觉断裂。
AI.method: 提出SEAM（镜头实体-属性记忆），包含：1）提取每帧多维状态；2）在图上检索因果先验上下文；3）选择性过滤；4）通过自然语言提示重写注入约束。同时发布SEAM-Bench双盲连续性故事板 benchmark。
AI.result: SEAM将跨剧集连续性召回率从0.700提升至0.946，泛化到六个主流文本模型，在生成图像层面也获得一致（虽不显著）提升。在CreativeFitting生产流程的201个镜头部署中，达到96.5%导演接受率，零unsafe注入；保守估计其跨剧集记忆至少贡献21.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: SEAM无需训练、模型无关，可无缝集成到现有短剧生成 pipeline，显著提升视觉连续性，为工业级短剧生成提供了有效的解决方案。

relevance_reason: This paper is about 2D VIDEO GENERATION (short drama generation with visual continuity), while the research profile is about 3D MOTION GENERATION (extracting 3D visual guidance features from 2D video and bridging to 3D motion space). Although both mention video generation models, the APPLICATION DOMAIN is fundamentally different - the paper focuses on maintaining visual consistency in 2D video frames, not on generating 3D motions. The methods and pain points do not align with the research profile's goal of 3D motion generation from 2D inputs.

title: ByteAction: Byte-space Action Recognition Foundation Model
summary: Byte-space Action Recognition (BAR) aims to recognize human actions directly from compressed image bitstreams without any pixel decoding. By operating entirely in byte space, BAR is inherently independent of file integrity and pixel-level reconstruction, making it naturally applicable to privacy-sensitive scenarios and robust against bitstream corruption. In this paper, we propose ByteAction, a BAR foundation model that achieves accurate action recognition on corrupted image bitstreams. ByteAction follows a dual-view byte-level recognition framework. It constructs weakly and strongly corrupted bitstream views, which are augmented by Bitstream Pattern Augmentation (BPA) and encoded with a shared ByteFormer backbone. The model is optimized with both classification and corruption consistency objectives. Specifically, we propose Bitstream Pattern Augmentation (BPA), which reshapes one-dimensional byte sequences into two-dimensional byte matrix and applies region-level erasure to encourage the model to learn robust cross-region byte dependencies. We further propose a Corruption Consistency Training strategy that constrains the model to maintain stable predictions across different corruption severities through bidirectional KL divergence. Experiments on the image bitstream from Stanford40, PPMI, and PASCAL VOC 2012 Action demonstrate that ByteAction achieves state-of-the-art corruption robustness across all scenarios while maintaining competitive intact bitstream performance.

AI.tldr: ByteAction是一个基于字节级动作识别的基础模型，能够直接从压缩图像比特流中识别人类动作，无需像素解码。该方法具有文件完整性独立性和对比特流损坏的鲁棒性，适用于隐私敏感场景。
AI.motivation: 现有动作识别方法依赖完整像素解码，在隐私敏感场景和比特流损坏场景下受限。Byte-space Action Recognition (BAR)直接在字节空间操作，具有固有的隐私保护性和损坏鲁棒性，但需要提高对损坏比特流的识别准确性。
AI.method: 提出Dual-view字节级识别框架，包含弱损坏和强损坏两个比特流视图。核心技术创新包括：(1) Bitstream Pattern Augmentation (BPA)：将一维字节序列重塑为二维字节矩阵，并应用区域级擦除，增强模型学习跨区域字节依赖关系；(2) Corruption Consistency Training：使用双向KL散度约束模型在不同损坏程度下保持稳定预测；(3) 共享ByteFormer编码器处理双视图。
AI.result: 在Stanford40、PPMI和PASCAL VOC 2012 Action三个数据集上进行实验，ByteAction在保持竞争力的完整比特流性能同时，实现了所有场景下的最先进损坏鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ByteAction作为BAR基础模型，能够在损坏的图像比特流上实现准确的动作识别，为隐私敏感场景和比特流损坏场景下的动作识别提供了有效解决方案。

The application domain mismatch is fundamental: ByteAction focuses on recognizing actions from video bytes, while the research profile needs methods for generating 3D motions from 2D video. The methods (byte-level bitstream processing, corruption-robust recognition) do not address any of the pain points related to 3D motion generation, video generation models, or VLM-based quality supervision. This is a Computer Vision paper that bears no relevance to Computer Graphics 3D motion generation research.

title: LLM-Based Selection of Incongruent Verbal and Nonverbal Behavior for Virtual Humans
summary: Nonverbal behavior generation systems for virtual agents often take an utterance as input and generate nonverbal behaviors that emphasize or illustrate the content of the verbal channel. However, human nonverbal behavior is shaped by more than the content of the speech. It is also influenced by speaker roles, interpersonal relationships, social context, and the cognitive and emotional states of the interactants. As a result, the nonverbal channel may reinforce, weaken, qualify, or even contradict the verbal channel. It may also reveal internal states that are hidden or only indirectly implied in speech, including emotional "leakage" that may be incidental to the immediate interaction. Modeling this richer relationship between verbal and nonverbal behavior is important for designing virtual agents that exhibit realistic, human-like behavior. It is especially critical in training contexts that require nuanced social interpretation, such as counseling simulations involving virtual patients. Drawing on Ekman's framework of verbal nonverbal relationships, we propose a taxonomy of categories in which mismatches between verbal and nonverbal behavior can occur. We then examine alternative approaches for realizing these behaviors using large language models, focusing on whether LLMs can select contextually appropriate mismatched verbal and nonverbal behaviors from a given dialogue and social interaction context. Finally, we evaluate the resulting behaviors in a human-subject study, assessing whether context-driven nonverbal behavior, when embodied in a virtual human, produces the intended effects on observers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究虚拟 agent 的非言语行为生成问题，提出基于 Ekman 框架的言语-非言语不一致分类法，探索大语言模型能否根据对话和社会情境选择合适的不一致行为，并通过人类受试者研究评估情境驱动的非言语行为效果。
AI.motivation: 当前非言语行为生成系统仅关注言语内容，忽视了说话者角色、人际关系、社会情境、认知和情感状态等因素的影响。非言语通道可以强化、弱化、限定甚至反驳言语通道，也可能泄露隐藏的情感状态。为了设计更真实、更像人类的虚拟 agent，尤其是在需要细微社会解读的训练场景（如虚拟患者咨询模拟）中，建模这种更丰富的言语-非言语关系至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 基于 Ekman 的言语-非言语关系框架，提出不一致行为的分类法；2) 探索使用大语言模型从给定对话和社会互动情境中选择上下文适当的不一致言语和非言语行为；3) 在人类受试者研究中评估这些行为，将情境驱动的非言语行为嵌入虚拟人身体，评估其对观察者的影响。

AI.conclusion: 本文贡献包括：1) 提出了言语-非言语不一致的分类法；2) 探索了 LLMs 在选择上下文适当的不一致行为方面的能力；3) 通过人类受试者研究验证了情境驱动的非言语行为的效果。这些工作为虚拟 agent 的非言语行为生成提供了新的理论基础和方法。

title: LagrangeGS: Non-Conservative Lagrangian System on Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) achieves photorealistic reconstruction of time-varying scenes, and recent physics-aware extensions improve extrapolation by explicitly predicting velocity fields. However, these extensions merely fit vector fields to visual deformations without satisfying Lagrangian mechanics, leading to three major issues: (i) physically inconsistent trajectories, (ii) lack of time-reversibility, and (iii) geometric collapse during long-term extrapolation. In this paper, we propose LagrangeGS, which formulates dynamic 3DGS as a non-conservative Lagrangian system. While this Lagrangian formulation fundamentally solves (i), a direct application of general LNNs to dynamic 3DGS requires a large velocity-Hessian inversion for millions of Gaussian particles. To overcome this computational bottleneck, we approximate the velocity-Hessian as an identity matrix, decoupling particle dynamics for computational tractability. For (ii), we restrict the non-conservative forces to be explicitly time independent, enabling consistent backward integration. Finally, to address (iii), we introduce local rigid alignment that regularizes particle trajectories. Extensive evaluations on dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate that LagrangeGS enables stable long-term extrapolation, consistent time reversal, and counterfactual physics-based editing without retraining.

AI.tldr: LagrangeGS提出将动态3D高斯溅射表述为非保守拉格朗日系统，通过速度-黑森矩阵近似和局部刚性对齐解决了物理一致性、时间可逆性和长期外推稳定性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有物理感知扩展仅将速度场拟合到视觉变形，未满足拉格朗日力学，导致物理不一致轨迹、缺乏时间可逆性和长期外推时几何崩溃三大问题。
AI.method: 将动态3DGS表述为非保守拉格朗日系统；近似速度-黑森矩阵为单位矩阵以解耦粒子动力学；限制非保守力显式时间无关以实现时间可逆性；引入局部刚性对齐正则化粒子轨迹。
AI.result: 在动态场景基准测试上的广泛评估表明，LagrangeGS能够实现稳定的长期外推、一致的时间逆转和无需重训练的反事实物理编辑。
AI.conclusion: LagrangeGS通过将动态3DGS表述为非保守拉格朗日系统从根本上解决了物理不一致性问题，通过速度-黑森矩阵近似为单位矩阵来克服计算瓶颈，并引入局部刚性对齐来防止长期外推中的几何崩溃。实验表明该方法能够实现稳定的长期外推、一致的时间逆转和反事实物理编辑。

While both are in Computer Graphics, the research profile focuses on extracting 3D guidance from video and generating 3D motions using video generation models and VLMs, whereas this paper addresses physics simulation for 3DGS representations. No alignment with the specific methods (video generation models, VLMs, feature extraction pipelines for motion generation) mentioned in the profile.

title: The Compaction Cliff in Long-Running AI Agent Memory
summary: A safety rule and an episodic log compete for the same tokens in an AI agent's context. When the budget overflows, both are summarized at the same rate; only the rule needs exact wording to remain enforceable. On 20 production agent configurations, Claude Code's /compact prompt on Sonnet 4.6 preserves 53\% of safety rules after one compaction round and 10\% after five. We name this the Compaction Cliff. We address it with Knowledge Triage, a framework that classifies each line of an agent's knowledge base by type and routes each type through its own retention policy. Three deterministic operators implement this triage across the three context-management operations: TypeCompact rewrites items in place under per-type fidelity, TypeDecompose partitions a topic too large to compact safely, replicating in-scope safety rules across partitions, and TypeRetrieve fetches items from external storage with in-scope rules pinned ahead of relevance. On five public corpora, TypeCompact preserves 2--4$\times$ more safety rules than the strongest single-shot LLM compactor at every ratio, with 96\% recall over five rounds. TypeDecompose reaches 0\% locality violations against 93\% under uniform partitioning. TypeRetrieve reaches 100\% recall@50 against 73\% for the best single-shot LLM retriever. On three downstream behavioral benchmarks, we outperform the production Sonnet compactor on medical compliance (paired McNemar $p < 10^{-8}$ on preservation, $N = 200$), the full-policy and hierarchical baselines on retail task pass rate ($p < 0.01$, $N = 115$), and the hierarchical compaction on the airline domain ($p = 0.024$). We release AgentArtifactCorpus (396{,}934 agent configurations from 54{,}628 public GitHub repositories), the classifier, and the reference implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"知识分类"(Knowledge Triage)框架,解决AI代理在上下文压缩时安全规则快速衰减的"压缩悬崖"问题。该框架通过将知识库按类型分类,为不同类型设置独立的保留策略,在三种上下文管理操作中实现分类压缩、分类分解和分类检索。实验表明该方法在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: AI代理的上下文存在安全规则和情节日志争夺token的问题。当预算溢出时,两者以相同速率被压缩,但安全规则需要精确措辞才能生效。现有压缩方法导致安全规则快速衰减,作者称之为"压缩悬崖"现象,这对代理的安全性构成严重威胁。
AI.method: 提出Knowledge Triage框架,将代理知识库的每行按类型分类,为每种类型设置独立的保留策略。实现三个确定性操作符:1)TypeCompact:按类型 fidelity 重写条目;2)TypeDecompose:将过大主题分区,在分区内复制安全规则;3)TypeRetrieve:从外部存储获取条目,将范围内规则优先于相关性固定。

title: Can We Perform Online RL for Image Editing without Editing Rewards?
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables direct preference optimization for image editing through editing-specific rewards, which remain less developed due to costly triplet supervision and complex task-dependent calibration. In contrast, text-to-image (T2I) generation benefits from a mature and diverse reward ecosystem spanning semantic alignment, aesthetics, realism, glyph shape, and other visual preferences. Extending this ecosystem to image editing would substantially broaden the range of visual preferences accessible to RL-based optimization, prompting the central question: \emph{Can We Perform Image Editing RL without Editing Rewards?} In this paper, we argue that the standard image editing dimensions have potential to be mapped to the T2I reward space: image quality can transfer directly, prompt following can be aligned through a description of the desired visual state, and reference consistency admits a coarse semantic conversion by encoding the source content to preserve. However, editing instructions specify relative changes, whereas T2I rewards require self-contained target descriptions; moreover, semantically valid captions from generic vision-language models may be incompatible with the frozen reward. Hence, we further introduce Lever-Edit, a two-stage framework that learns a reward-aligned captioner for counterfactual target descriptions, freezes it, and optimizes the editing policy solely with the transferred T2I reward. Experiments show competitive editing alignment and source preservation against editing-reward-based fine-tuning, while outperforming intuitive transfer baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Lever-Edit框架，通过将文本到图像(T2I)奖励迁移到图像编辑任务中，实现无需编辑奖励的强化学习图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 图像编辑的强化学习缺乏专门的奖励模型，现有编辑奖励需要昂贵的 triplet 监督和复杂的任务相关校准；而T2I领域已拥有成熟的奖励生态系统，因此提出问题：能否在不使用编辑奖励的情况下进行图像编辑RL？
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架 Lever-Edit：1) 学习一个奖励对齐的 captioner 用于生成反事实目标描述；2) 冻结 captioner，仅使用迁移的 T2I 奖励优化编辑策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在编辑对齐和源图像保留方面与基于编辑奖励的微调方法具有竞争力，并优于直观的迁移基线。
AI.conclusion: 标准图像编辑维度可以被映射到 T2I 奖励空间，无需专门设计编辑奖励即可实现有效的 RL 图像编辑。

title: Compositional Chain-of-Relations for Faithful Knowledge Graph Question Answering with Large Language Models
summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) is a key task for evaluating KG-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs), and complex KGQA that requires multi-hop reasoning is especially challenging. Solving a complex query involves two coupled phases: candidate retrieval, which locates answer candidates over the KG, and constraint handling, which filters these candidates against the query constraints. Faithful reasoning requires grounding both phases in the KG. However, existing agent-based methods ground candidate retrieval through entity-centric exploration, while leaving constraint handling to the LLM's internal knowledge, which leads to two critical limitations. (1) Unreliable entity pruning: entity-centric exploration uses entities as search units and must prune them to a fixed-size subset at each hop. Because entity information in KGs is often incomplete and a fixed-size subset cannot retain all valid entities, such pruning inevitably drops valid entities and ultimately leads to wrong answers. (2) Ungrounded constraint handling: query constraints are resolved from the LLM's internal knowledge rather than the KG, leaving the final answers unverifiable and prone to hallucination. To address these limitations, this paper introduces a relation-centric exploration paradigm, which uses relations rather than entities as search units and thus avoids unreliable entity pruning. Built on this paradigm, this paper proposes Compositional Chain-of-Relations (CCoR), a simple and effective framework that grounds both phases in the KG with two relation chains: a main chain for candidate retrieval and a constraint chain that verifies query constraints through explicit KG exploration. Experiments on four KGQA benchmarks show that CCoR consistently improves accuracy, faithfulness, and efficiency over strong baselines, with more pronounced gains on complex queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为组合关系链(CCoR)的新框架，用于解决知识图谱问答(KGQA)中的复杂多跳推理问题。该框架采用以关系为中心的探索范式，避免了传统以实体为中心方法中不可靠的实体剪枝问题，并将候选检索和约束处理两个阶段都建立在知识图谱之上。
AI.motivation: 现有基于代理的KGQA方法存在两个关键局限：(1)不可靠的实体剪枝：以实体为搜索单元需要在每跳将实体剪枝到固定大小子集，导致有效实体被丢弃；(2)未扎根的约束处理：约束处理依赖于LLM内部知识而非知识图谱，导致最终答案无法验证且易产生幻觉。
AI.method: 提出以关系为中心的探索范式，使用关系而非实体作为搜索单元，从而避免不可靠的实体剪枝。在此范式基础上，提出CCoR框架，通过两条关系链将两个阶段都扎根于知识图谱：主链用于候选检索，约束链用于通过显式知识图谱探索验证查询约束。
AI.result: 在四个KGQA基准数据集上的实验表明，CCoR在准确率、忠诚度和效率方面均优于强基线方法，且在复杂查询上的提升更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过以关系为中心的探索范式和CCoR框架，成功解决了KGQA中实体剪枝和约束处理接地的问题，显著提升了复杂多跳推理的表现。

title: OmicSync: Reliability-Aware Spatial Multi-Omics Clustering with Evidence-Constrained LLM Reasoning
summary: Spatial multi-omics technologies jointly profile gene expression, surface proteins, and histology at each tissue spot, yet most spatial domain discovery methods provide only cluster assignments, without indicating assignment reliability, modality contributions, or why a domain decision should be trusted. We present OmicSync, a reliability-aware spatial multi-omics framework that couples unsupervised domain clustering with evidence-constrained LLM reasoning using model-derived per-spot signals, including assignment confidence, epistemic routing uncertainty, and modality-routing weights. These signals are converted into structured evidence dictionaries and used to generate standard, stepwise, counterfactual, contrastive, and uncertainty-focused explanations. OmicSync integrates a KAN-GCN backbone with spatial encoding, cross-modal fusion, uncertainty-aware routing, cell-type supervision, and missing-modality imputation. We further introduce OmicSync-R, which closes the reasoning-clustering loop by using automatically computed reasoning-quality scores as REINFORCE rewards, allowing reasoning coherence to shape the latent structure without backpropagating through the language model. Across four 10x CytAssist FFPE spatial proteomics benchmarks, OmicSync achieves the best average rank on Human Tonsil (1.44), Glioblastoma (1.78), and Tonsil Add-on (1.22), and second-best on Human Breast Cancer (2.33). OmicSync-R further improves ARI on Human Breast Cancer from 45.73 to 46.72 and outperforms existing methods on six of nine clustering metrics. Together, OmicSync and OmicSync-R enable reliability-aware, spot-level auditable spatial domain discovery guided by evidence-constrained reasoning.

AI.tldr: OmicSync是一个可靠性感知的空间多组学框架，将无监督域聚类与证据约束的LLM推理相结合，通过模型衍生的每点信号（分配置信度、认知路由不确定性和模态路由权重）生成多种解释。该方法在4个10x CytAssist FFPE空间蛋白质组学基准数据集上取得了最佳或次佳的排名，OmicSync-R进一步提升了聚类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间域发现方法仅提供聚类分配，缺乏分配可靠性、模态贡献以及为何应信任某个域决策的解释能力。这限制了方法的可解释性和可信度。

AI.conclusion: OmicSync和OmicSync-R实现了可靠性感知、可在点级别审计的空间域发现，由证据约束推理指导。未来工作将扩展到更多模态和更大规模的图谱数据集。
